items.title: 〈觀察〉三大台系PCB廠前3季汽車板銷售都突破百億元健鼎仍居冠軍
items.title_en: Observation: The Three Major Taiwanese PCB Makers All Exceeded NT$10 Billion in Automotive Board Sales in the First Three Quarters of 2026, with Kenda Still Leading
paras: 健鼎(3044-TW)自2012年大舉切入汽車板市場以來，健鼎在2023年憑藉高產能的HDI製程擊敗敬鵬(2355-TW)，首度登上台廠汽車板出貨王寶座。同時，依最新財報顯示，2026年前三季包括健鼎、定穎(3715-TW)及敬鵬三大台系汽車板廠出貨金額都突破100億元，合計達342.07億元，其中並以健鼎120.72億元居冠，年增13.43%。
同時，汽車板市場需求已經趨於穩定，但在PCB上游CCL嚴重缺貨的壓抑之下，並已出現向小廠退出的現象，也將使這一區塊的市場更走上強者恒強強的走勢。
就2026年1-9月汽車板市場銷售冠軍的健鼎(3044-TW)來看，雖然網通與伺服器、記憶體模組板仍因AI需求提升而分別居銷售金額前二名，且 網通與伺服器已連續兩個季度占營收比重逾40%，且因營收的的快速成長，使汽車板的營收比重一路逐季下滑。
在2026年第三季健鼎營收306.94億元，通與伺服器板占比達41.2%，記憶體模組板占27.9%，汽車板占比下滑到15.2%，但累計健鼎2026年1-9月汽車板營收以120.72億元居三大汽車板廠之冠，且年增13.43%。
而第二名的定穎在汽車板的比重，在2026年以來則由54%、55%及57%一路攀升，定穎在2026年第三季營收87.05億元創新高，汽車板營收季增33%，營收占比並挺升到57%，也使定穎在2026年第三季單一汽車類別營收達49.52億元，也比健鼎的單46.65億元高。
定穎在2026年1-9月汽車板的營收117.8億元，較2025年同期的85.74億元，則出現37.39%的高幅成長。
而第三名的敬鵬在2026年1-3季營收131.08億元，但敬鵬對產品結構重新分類，對AI基建及航天類別產品獨立爲一類，營收占比爲9%，在汽車電子占比爲62%，同時，在先進駕駛輔助系統（ADAS）及智慧駕艙應用板占比爲19%，合計在汽車應用上占比79%，已經優於2025年2025年全年平均占比的77%。
敬鵬在2026年1-9月汽車板營收達103.55億元，也較2025年同期的85.74億元成長17.1%。
敬鵬2026年1-9月營收131.09億元，毛利率15.21%，年增4.54個百分點，2026年1-3季稅後純益達9.6億元，年增1.52倍，並且超越2025年全年獲利，每股純益達2.42元。
法人看好，敬鵬2026年整體營運可望較去年回升，隨著泰國新廠產能陸續加入，加上公司多年深耕泰國PCB市場、累積成熟的生產經驗，敬鵬在2027年成長動能也備受關注。法人預期，隨著汽車板需求穩健，加上泰國新產能挹注，敬鵬2026年營運可望優於去年，2027年成長表現更值得期待。
由於汽車板市場需求回穩有利敬鵬營收、敬鵬並跨足工業控制電子板逐漸有成，工業電子控制板在今年取得新訂單，業績預估將由今年下半年起走高，同時，敬鵬除在泰國生產基地原廠完成改造投產之外，新建生產大樓的新投資進展順利，預計2027年還有新產能投產，且目前對 CCL成本節節上攀的營運干擾，並已陸續向客戶端反映。
paras_en: Kenda (3044‑TW) entered the automotive board market on a large scale in 2012 and, thanks to its high‑capacity HDI process, beat Jingpeng (2355‑TW) in 2023 to become Taiwan’s top automotive board shipper for the first time. According to the latest financial report, the three major Taiwanese automotive‑board manufacturers—Kenda, Dingying (3715‑TW) and Jingpeng—each shipped over NT$10 billion in the first three quarters of 2026, totalling NT$342.07 billion, with Kenda leading at NT$120.72 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 13.43%.

At the same time, demand for automotive boards has stabilised, but severe shortages of CCL upstream in the PCB supply chain are forcing smaller players to exit, further concentrating the market among the strongest firms.

Looking at Kenda (3044‑TW), the 2026 Q1‑Q3 automotive‑board market champion, its network‑communication, server and memory‑module boards remain the top two revenue sources thanks to rising AI demand. Network‑communication and server boards have accounted for more than 40% of revenue for two consecutive quarters, and the rapid growth of those segments has caused the share of automotive‑board revenue to decline quarter by quarter.

In Q3 2026 Kenda posted revenue of NT$306.94 billion, with network‑communication and server boards making up 41.2%, memory‑module boards 27.9%, and automotive boards falling to 15.2%. Nevertheless, its cumulative automotive‑board revenue of NT$120.72 billion for the year‑to‑date remains the highest among the three manufacturers, up 13.43% year‑over‑year.

The second‑place maker Dingying saw its automotive‑board share rise steadily to 54%, 55% and 57% in 2026. Dingying achieved a record Q3 2026 revenue of NT$87.05 billion, with automotive‑board revenue jumping 33% quarter‑over‑quarter and its share climbing to 57%. This gave Dingying automotive‑board revenue of NT$49.52 billion in Q3, surpassing Kenda’s NT$46.65 billion.
Dingying’s automotive‑board revenue for the first three quarters of 2026 was NT$117.8 billion, compared with NT$85.74 billion in the same period of 2025, a strong 37.39% increase.

The third‑place player Jingpeng recorded NT$131.08 billion in revenue for Q1‑Q3 2026. Jingpeng re‑classified its product mix, separating AI‑infrastructure and aerospace products into a distinct category (9% of revenue). Automotive electronics now account for 62% of revenue, with ADAS and smart‑cabin application boards contributing 19%, bringing the total automotive‑related share to 79%, up from an average of 77% for the full year of 2025.
Jingpeng’s automotive‑board revenue reached NT$103.55 billion in the first three quarters of 2026, up 17.1% from NT$85.74 billion in the same period of 2025.

Jingpeng posted NT$131.09 billion in revenue for Q1‑Q3 2026, with a gross margin of 15.21%, up 4.54 percentage points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax for Q1‑Q3 was NT$9.6 billion, a 1.52‑fold increase over the prior year, surpassing full‑year 2025 earnings, and earnings per share reached NT$2.42.

Institutional investors are optimistic that Jingpeng’s overall 2026 operations will improve over the previous year. With the new Thai plant’s capacity coming online and the company’s long‑standing presence and mature production experience in Thailand’s PCB market, Jingpeng’s growth momentum in 2027 is also drawing attention. Analysts expect that steady automotive‑board demand, bolstered by the new Thai capacity, will make Jingpeng’s 2026 performance better than 2025, with even more promising growth in 2027.

Because automotive‑board demand has stabilised, it benefits Jingpeng’s revenue, and the company’s expansion into industrial‑control electronic boards is gaining traction. New industrial‑control board orders are expected to lift performance from the second half of this year onward. In addition to completing the refurbishment and start‑up of its original Thai production base, Jingpeng’s new manufacturing building is progressing smoothly, with another new capacity slated to come online in 2027. The firm is also actively addressing the rising CCL cost pressures that have been affecting operations, communicating these issues to its customers.

items.title: 黃仁勳離職《大賣空》貝瑞再加碼放空科技股！警告AI熱潮或陷入「牛市陷阱」
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's Resignation Prompts Michael Burry to Deepen Tech Short Bets, Warning AI Hype May Be a Bull‑Market Trap
paras: 隨著輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳離職令科技股前景蒙上陰影，知名投資人、電影《大賣空》原型人物貝瑞（Michael Burry）再度加碼放空科技股，認為人工智慧（AI）熱潮可能正形成一場「牛市陷阱」。他將那斯達克100指數近期高點比擬為2000年網路泡沫破裂前的市場頂峰，並押注晶片股及整體科技板塊將在2027年年中前出現顯著修正。
貝瑞在Substack最新文章中，以「見證牛市陷阱」（Behold the bull-trap）為題，引用那斯達克100指數10月6日觸及的階段性高點，認為市場可能已在不知不覺中見頂。
他將當前市場情勢與2000年3月網路泡沫高峰相提並論，當時科技股估值大幅偏離基本面，隨後引發長期市場崩跌。
貝瑞進一步透露，已於11月12日趁那斯達克100指數反彈至27,000點之際，將相關看跌期權部位加碼至原先的兩倍，履約日期設定在2027年初，目前履約價格約低於指數現價20%。
此外，他也重新建立先前已平倉的VanEck半導體指數VanEck Vectors 半導體 ETF(SMH-US) 看跌期權部位。

黃仁勳離職成看空催化劑 點名輝達及AI雲端業者

輝達執行長黃仁勳離職的消息，進一步強化貝瑞對科技股的看空立場。他在Substack針對此事發文，直接建議投資人「離場」，認為領導層更替將對輝達的獲利率及成長動能造成負面影響，衝擊也可能沿著AI產業鏈擴散。
貝瑞隨後進一步列出他認為可能受到波及的企業，特別是與輝達關係密切、共同參與AI基礎設施建置及融資的業者，包括新興雲端運算服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 與Nebius(NBIS-US) ，兩家公司都是輝達GPU的大型客戶。
貝瑞指出，這些企業組成的投資組合過去一個月經歷劇烈波動，過去均深度受惠於輝達的市場主導地位及資源外溢效應，但如今產業似乎正進入新的局面。
他表示，自己正在尋找輝達市場影響力明顯減弱的跡象。

放空策略轉向半導體ETF 押注2027年產業鏈修正

值得注意的是，貝瑞近幾個月已調整放空策略。根據他10月披露的布局，其空頭部位已從先前針對輝達及Palantir(PLTR-US) 等個股的押注，轉向更廣泛的市場指數，主要透過VanEck半導體ETF看跌期權布局。
黃仁勳離職消息傳出後，這項策略也更聚焦於半導體產業鏈。由於輝達與台積電(2330-TW) 均為VanEck半導體ETF的最大持股，兩家公司的前景不確定性，也成為貝瑞看空該ETF的重要依據。
整體而言，貝瑞仍維持原先判斷，認為晶片股估值過高，並預期半導體及整體科技產業將在2027年迎來一波顯著修正。
paras_en: As Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang steps down, casting a shadow over tech‑stock outlooks, famed investor and the real‑life inspiration for the film "The Big Short," Michael Burry is once again increasing his short exposure to tech equities, arguing that the AI frenzy could be turning into a "bull‑market trap." He likens the recent Nasdaq‑100 peak to the market top before the 2000 dot‑com bust and bets that chip stocks and the broader tech sector will see a sharp correction before mid‑2027.
In a new Substack post titled "Behold the bull‑trap," Burry points to the Nasdaq‑100’s interim high reached on October 6 as evidence that the market may have quietly topped out.
He draws a parallel between today’s conditions and the March 2000 dot‑com peak, when tech valuations had strayed far from fundamentals and subsequently triggered a prolonged market decline.

Burry disclosed that on November 12, as the Nasdaq‑100 rebounded to about 27,000 points, he doubled his bearish options position, setting expirations for early 2027 with strike prices roughly 20% below the current index level.
He also re‑established a previously closed short position in put options on the VanEck Vectors Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US).

Huang’s departure is a catalyst for Burry’s bearish stance. In his Substack note he urges investors to "exit," arguing that a leadership change will hurt Nvidia’s margins and growth momentum, with fallout likely to spread along the AI supply chain.

Burry then listed firms he believes could be hit, especially those closely tied to Nvidia and involved in building and financing AI infrastructure, such as emerging cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (NBIS‑US), both large Nvidia GPU customers.

He noted that the portfolio of these companies has experienced extreme volatility over the past month, having previously benefited heavily from Nvidia’s market dominance and spill‑over effects, but now the industry appears to be entering a new phase.
He said he is looking for signs that Nvidia’s market influence is waning.

It is noteworthy that Burry has shifted his short strategy in recent months. According to his October disclosures, his bearish bets have moved from individual stocks like Nvidia and Palantir (PLTR‑US) to broader market indices, primarily through put options on the VanEck Semiconductor ETF.

After news of Huang’s resignation, the strategy has become even more focused on the semiconductor supply chain. Since Nvidia and Taiwan Semiconductor (2330‑TW) are the largest holdings in the VanEck Semiconductor ETF, uncertainty around both companies underpins Burry’s short case on the ETF.
Overall, Burry sticks to his original view that chip stocks are overvalued and expects a significant correction in the semiconductor and broader tech sectors by 2027.

items.title: 台股震盪、企業獲利卻創高！AI三雄營收破紀錄 00961掌握科技金融雙引擎
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Fluctuate, Yet Corporate Profits Hit New Highs! AI Trio Posts Record Revenues, 00961 Leverages Dual Tech and Finance Engines
paras: 台股近期上演急跌急漲行情，市場情緒隨國際政經消息劇烈擺盪，但企業基本面卻傳出截然不同的訊號。台灣10月出口衝上967.6億美元，年增58.9%，創單月歷史新高；台積電 (2330-TW) 10月營收達5,868.9億元，年增59.7%，同步刷新紀錄。隨著上市櫃公司10月營收陸續揭曉，AI伺服器供應鏈出貨暢旺、金融業獲利穩健，為台股中長線行情增添基本面支撐。
富蘭克林華美投信（00961-TW）FT臺灣永續高息經理人江明鴻指出，股市短線難免受到外資籌碼、利率政策與國際事件干擾，但真正決定企業長期價值的，仍是訂單能否轉化為營收、營收能否進一步創造獲利。從最新公布的經濟數據與企業財報觀察，台灣科技產業需求並未因股價震盪而明顯降溫，中長期仍可審慎樂觀看待。
其中，AI伺服器供應鏈表現尤其突出。華碩10月營收達1,076.2億元，年增62.3%，創歷史新高；廣達與緯創同月營收年增率更分別達約104%及117.6%，雙雙繳出翻倍成長成績單。隨著全球雲端服務商持續擴建AI基礎設施，相關訂單逐步轉化為實際出貨，顯示AI投資熱潮正從資本支出承諾，進一步反映在台灣供應鏈營收。
除了科技股成長動能強勁，金融族群也展現獲利韌性。上海商銀前10月累計稅後純益約164.15億元，年增約22%，每股盈餘達3.35元，前十個月獲利已超越去年全年。相較科技股受惠AI設備需求，金融股則可從核心業務與獲利累積提供不同收益來源，成為市場震盪期間值得關注的配置方向。
江明鴻表示，對於希望兼顧資本成長與現金流的投資人而言，高股息ETF不能只比較配息率，更應檢視成分股的獲利能力、產業分布與股利延續性。尤其當市場波動加劇，企業是否具備穩定創造現金流與持續成長的能力，將影響長期投資成果。以00961為例，透過科技成長與金融獲利兩大主軸，參與AI產業擴張及金融業經營成果，降低投資組合對單一產業的依賴。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has recently seen rapid drops and rallies, with market sentiment swinging sharply on international political and economic news, while corporate fundamentals are sending a completely different signal. Taiwan’s October exports surged to $96.76 billion, up 58.9% year‑on‑year, setting a new monthly record; TSMC (2330‑TW) posted October revenue of NT$586.89 billion, up 59.7% year‑on‑year, also a record. As listed companies release their October revenues, strong shipments in the AI server supply chain and solid earnings in the financial sector are adding fundamental support to Taiwan’s medium‑ to long‑term market outlook.

Franklin Templeton (00961‑TW) manager Jiang Ming‑hong of FT Taiwan Sustainable High‑Yield noted that short‑term market moves are inevitably affected by foreign‑capital flows, interest‑rate policy and global events, but the true driver of a company’s long‑term value remains whether orders can be turned into revenue and whether that revenue can generate profit. From the latest economic data and corporate earnings, demand for Taiwan’s tech industry has not cooled noticeably despite stock‑price volatility, allowing a cautiously optimistic medium‑ to long‑term view.

The AI server supply chain stood out in particular. ASUS reported October revenue of NT$107.62 billion, up 62.3% year‑on‑year, a historic high; Quanta and Wistron posted year‑on‑year revenue growth of roughly 104% and 117.6% respectively, both delivering double‑digit growth scores. As global cloud providers continue to expand AI infrastructure, related orders are gradually turning into actual shipments, showing that the AI investment boom is moving from capital‑expenditure commitments to tangible revenue for Taiwan’s supply chain.

Beyond the strong growth momentum in tech stocks, the financial sector also demonstrated earnings resilience. Shanghai Commercial Bank recorded a cumulative after‑tax profit of about NT$16.415 billion for the first ten months of the year, up roughly 22% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of NT$3.35, already surpassing its full‑year profit from the previous year. While tech stocks benefit from AI equipment demand, financial stocks draw from core business and profit accumulation, offering a different source of returns and becoming a noteworthy allocation theme during market turbulence.

Jiang emphasized that investors seeking both capital growth and cash flow should not judge high‑dividend ETFs solely by yield, but also examine the profitability of constituent stocks, sector allocation and dividend sustainability. Especially when market volatility intensifies, a company’s ability to generate stable cash flow and sustain growth will affect long‑term investment outcomes. Using 00961 as an example, its focus on both tech growth and financial earnings allows participation in AI industry expansion and financial sector performance, reducing portfolio reliance on any single industry.

items.title: AI伺服器成PC大廠2027年成長動能 華碩拚高雙位數增長、技嘉擴產搶市
items.title_en: AI Servers to Drive PC Giants' Growth in 2027: Asus Targets Double‑Digit Growth, Gigabyte Expands Production to Capture Market
paras: 台灣個人電腦與板卡品牌大廠華碩(2357-TW)、技嘉(2376-TW)近期召開法說會，釋出最新AI伺服器營運展望與全球產能規劃。三大廠一致看好AI伺服器成為驅動2027年營運成長的核心動能，其中華碩預估2026年第四季伺服器營收季增150%，技嘉則指出AI伺服器訂單能見度已直達2027年底
在具體財務數據與營運展望方面，華碩財務長吳長榮表示，受惠於強勁訂單動能與部分2026年第三季遞延訂單出貨，預估第四季伺服器營收將迎來爆發性增長，單季季增達150%，年增更高達280%。
華碩共同執行長許先越與胡書賓皆強調，儘管第三季有部分資料中心客戶因部署時程延後導致出貨遞延至第四季認列，第三季伺服器營收仍年增100%，占整體品牌營收比重達30%，且全年伺服器營收有信心達成至少150%以上的成長目標。
展望2027年營運表現，華碩共同執行長胡書賓指出，2027年伺服器業務達成雙位數甚至高雙位數年成長相當有把握，內部更以挑戰三位數成長為企圖心。
技嘉集團共同總經理李宜泰同樣表示，目前客戶對AI伺服器訂單需求非常強勁且能見度持續提高，成長動能可望一路延續至2027年底，發言人劉文忠更預期隨經濟規模擴大與費用率優化，2027年營業利益的成長幅度將優於營收成長幅度。
因應客戶強勁需求，技嘉持續調整全球生產布局並擴大資本支出，劉文忠透露2026年資本支出預計約為28至30億元新台幣，2027年資本支出規劃則預估提高至40億元新台幣。
在全球產能配置上，技嘉台灣廠將持續強化產能擴充並支援高階產品製造、工程及系統整合需求，美國廠作為提升北美市場在地供應彈性、加速客戶認證及發揮交付效率的核心，馬來西亞及其他東南亞基地則依客戶需求與供應鏈策略逐步擴充產能。
在伺服器產品線擴展方面，企業客戶為支援AI工作負載而擴建地端資料中心，同步為華碩通用型CPU伺服器帶來顯著帶動效應。胡書賓透露，華碩2026年第三季通用型CPU伺服器營收年增80%，占內部伺服器營收比重已達20%，未來除GPU伺服器外，通用型CPU伺服器也將是積極布局的重點。
至於技嘉2027年新專案來源，劉文忠分析成長動能主要來自整體市場需求擴張、新客戶數量增加，以及針對既有客戶提供涵蓋硬體、軟體與液冷機櫃等更多元的產品方案。
針對外部環境與產業趨勢變化，胡書賓分析近期市場出現資本市場融資條件趨緊與美國期中大選後地方政府對資料中心監管趨嚴兩大變化，可能導致體質不佳的Tier 2與Tier 3雲端服務商或NeoCloud面臨整併與淘汰，促使未來產業更集中於財務穩定、能掌握能源且兼顧環境與社區發展的核心玩家手中，而華碩2026年第四季及2027年已核准的建設案與訂單需求並未遇到延遲。
李宜泰則強調，技嘉在Neocloud客戶盡職調查與風險控制上維持穩健營運品質，並透過維持客戶組合與系統策略彈性控管風險，同時面對未來NVIDIA新管理團隊上任，雙方從管理層到執行面、產品與行銷皆有由上而下的深入合作，整體配合策略不會改變。
paras_en: Taiwan's major PC and motherboard brands Asus (2357‑TW) and Gigabyte (2376‑TW) recently held earnings calls, unveiling their latest AI server operating outlooks and global capacity plans. All three leading companies see AI servers as the core driver of growth through 2027, with Asus forecasting a 150% quarter‑over‑quarter increase in server revenue for Q4 2026 and Gigabyte noting that AI server order visibility extends to the end of 2027.

Regarding specific financial figures and outlook, Asus CFO Wu Chang‑Jung said that strong order momentum and the shipment of some deferred Q3 2026 orders will trigger explosive growth in Q4 server revenue, with a 150% sequential increase and an annual rise of up to 280%.

Asus co‑CEOs Hsu Hsien‑Yue and Hu Shu‑Pin emphasized that, although some data‑center customers delayed deployments and shifted shipments to Q4, Q3 server revenue still grew 100% year‑over‑year, accounting for 30% of total brand revenue, and the company is confident that full‑year server revenue will achieve at least 150% growth.

Looking ahead to 2027 performance, Asus co‑CEO Hu Shu‑Pin said the company is confident of achieving double‑digit, even high double‑digit, annual growth in the server business, and internally is aiming for triple‑digit growth as an ambition.

Gigabyte Group co‑General Manager Li Yi‑Tai also stated that customer demand for AI server orders is very strong and visibility continues to improve, with growth momentum expected to carry through to the end of 2027. Spokesperson Liu Wen‑Chung further projected that, as the economy scales and cost efficiencies improve, 2027 operating profit growth will outpace revenue growth.

In response to strong customer demand, Gigabyte is continuously adjusting its global production layout and expanding capital expenditures. Liu Wen‑Chung disclosed that capital spending for 2026 is expected to be around NT$2.8‑3.0 billion, with a planned increase to NT$4.0 billion in 2027.

Regarding global capacity allocation, Gigabyte’s Taiwan plant will keep strengthening capacity expansion to support high‑end product manufacturing, engineering and system‑integration needs. The U.S. plant serves as the core for enhancing local supply flexibility in North America, accelerating customer certification and delivery efficiency, while the Malaysia and other Southeast Asian sites will gradually expand capacity according to customer demand and supply‑chain strategy.

On the server product line expansion, enterprise customers are building edge data centers to support AI workloads, which in turn significantly boosts Asus’s general‑purpose CPU servers. Hu Shu‑Pin revealed that Asus’s Q3 2026 general‑purpose CPU server revenue grew 80% year‑over‑year, now representing 20% of internal server revenue, and that beyond GPU servers, general‑purpose CPU servers will remain a key focus for future deployment.

As for Gigabyte’s new project sources in 2027, Liu Wen‑Chung analyzed that growth will mainly stem from overall market demand expansion, an increase in new customers, and offering existing customers more diversified solutions covering hardware, software and liquid‑cooling racks.

Addressing external environment and industry trend changes, Hu Shu‑Pin noted two recent shifts: tighter capital‑market financing conditions and stricter post‑midterm‑election data‑center regulations by U.S. local governments. These could force weaker Tier 2 and Tier 3 cloud providers or NeoClouds into consolidation or exit, concentrating the industry around financially stable players with energy control and environmental and community development focus. Asus’s approved construction projects and order demand for Q4 2026 and 2027 have not faced delays.

Li Yi‑Tai emphasized that Gigabyte maintains robust operational quality in NeoCloud customer due diligence and risk control, managing portfolio and system‑strategy flexibility to mitigate risk. He also noted that with NVIDIA’s new management team taking over, both parties will deepen cooperation from leadership to execution, product and marketing, and the overall partnership strategy will remain unchanged.

items.title: 馬斯克力挺黃仁勳！稱輝達少了他恐失「關鍵交易」：許多合作只靠握手承諾
items.title_en: Musk Backs Jensen Huang! Says Nvidia Would Lose “Key Deals” Without Him: Many Collaborations Rely Only on Handshake Promises
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克周六（14日）在社群平台 X 發文表示，若輝達(NVDA-US) 現已遭撤換的執行長黃仁勳不再掌舵，公司將失去一些「關鍵」交易。
馬斯克指出，黃仁勳在輝達供應鏈管理方面表現「出色」，但許多重要交易其實是「與黃仁勳本人握手達成的協議，而非白紙黑字的合約」。
他表示：「少了黃仁勳，輝達至少會失去部分這類關鍵交易。」
馬斯克隨後也補充說：「如果黃仁勳向我承諾會交付運算資源，或我請他加快零組件供貨速度，他總是說到做到。當然，我們之後某個時間點還是會補上採購訂單，但我從來沒有一刻懷疑過這些承諾不會兌現。」
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk posted on X on Saturday (the 14th) that if Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang, who has now been removed, no longer leads the company, it will lose some “key” deals.

Musk pointed out that Huang has performed “outstandingly” in managing Nvidia’s supply chain, but many important deals are actually “agreements reached by shaking hands with Huang himself, rather than written contracts on paper.”
He said: “Without Jensen Huang, Nvidia will at least lose a portion of these kinds of key deals.”

Musk added: “If Jensen Huang promises me delivery of compute resources, or I ask him to speed up component supply, he always follows through. Of course, we will later place the purchase orders, but I have never once doubted that these promises would be fulfilled.”

items.title: 輝達間諜風暴敲響警鐘！AI圈重金延攬前情報官 頂尖資安主管薪酬上看400萬美元
items.title_en: Nvidia Spy Storm Sounds Alarm! AI Industry Lavishes on Former Intelligence Officers, Top Cybersecurity Executives Earn Up to $4 Million
paras: 隨著人工智慧(AI)產業快速擴張，科技公司正積極延攬曾在情報機構任職的人才，以防範間諜活動、商業機密竊取及勒索威脅。在輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳婚外情對象被指控是中國間諜，讓這項安全風險格外受關注。
前情報官員、招募業者及企業內部人士指出，近年受惠於AI需求大幅成長的晶片及科技公司，正持續擴編安全團隊。
前美國特勤局探員、現任Insite Risk Management總裁Christopher Falkenberg說：「AI公司已大量延攬安全人才。政府部門有一些非常專業的人才，正在思考如何保障這些企業的安全……具備相關經驗的人才供不應求。」
輝達本周四宣布，創辦人黃仁勳將卸下職務，消息震撼公司及整個AI產業。黃仁勳已承認其中一段婚外情，輝達表示不認為國家安全或企業機密因此外洩，中國則否認間諜活動相關指控。

反情報職務近年明顯增加

追蹤企業招募趨勢的Revelio Labs指出，反情報職缺是前沿AI公司近年才出現的新現象，OpenAI、Anthropic及輝達等公司陸續刊登更明確的相關職位，薪資多介於20萬至50萬美元。
前中央情報局(CIA)官員、現任策略風險與安全顧問公司Control Risks專家Catherine Marinis-Yaqub表示，企業看重反情報專家辨識商業機密竊取，以及有人透過企業高層的弱點進行勒索或脅迫等威脅的能力。
她也協助企業高層辨識健身房、咖啡店等日常場合中，可能試圖接近、勒索或招募他們的間諜。她說：「企業開始更加意識到這些風險，但還有很長一段路要走。」

AI巨頭也需要人類情報

OpenAI於2024年6月任命前美國國家安全局(NSA)局長Paul Nakasone加入董事會及安全委員會，目前也正招募一名資深全球安全調查主管，把反情報列為重要技能之一。
OpenAI今年10月解雇一名工程師，原因是在高層會議室的電視後方發現隱藏錄音裝置，但這名遭控安裝裝置的工程師目前否認非法竊聽的指控。
競爭對手Anthropic則在延攬前CIA副局長David Cohen及前NSA網路安全主管Dave Luber，加入該公司的國家安全顧問委員會。近期一則招募威脅情報安全工程師的資訊中，自述是「全球最受民族國家及高階犯罪分子覬覦的目標之一」。
專業招募公司SI Placement創辦人Kathy Lavinder表示，相關人才稀有，使企業薪酬遠高於公部門，企業界的頂尖資安主管每年薪酬可達100萬至400萬美元，視股票獎酬而定。

ASML也要抓間諜 在台招募情報主管

歐洲市值最高的上市公司艾司摩爾(ASML-US)也加強安全防禦，以因應晶片製造設備技術在美中科技競爭中的風險。
ASML前幾年就成立「情報融合中心」(Intelligence Fusion Centre)，目前正在招募派駐台灣的情報主管。台灣是最大客戶台積電(TSM-TW)(2330-TW)的所在地，而台積電為輝達生產晶片。
招聘資訊描述的工作內容，宛如間諜小說中的角色，任務是揪出間諜活動、破壞及恐怖主義等「內部威脅」，應徵者須具備至少10年反情報工作經驗。
ASML拒絕對此置評，但公開文件顯示，該公司的安全部門人力在過去10年間快速增加，2024年更聘用了曾任荷蘭軍事情報局副局長的Sebastian Reyn。
海牙戰略研究中心分析師Hans Horan說：「ASML是安全風險管理方面較為成熟的企業之一，因為它一直是攻擊目標。」

誰來監視企業老闆？高層私生活仍是資安漏洞

曾任ASML安全主管、現為網路安全合作公司CyberAlloy負責人的Aernout Reijmer表示，資安主管目前優先處理AI駭客攻擊及企業採用AI後的資料保護，卻可能因此忽略企業高層落入間諜陷阱的風險。
Reijmer說：「我認為有90%的企業完全忽略這項風險，因為只要一提到這件事，大家腦中馬上就會響起《007》電影的主題曲。」
他指出，大型科技公司及銀行通常已建立相當完善的防禦機制，但在全球地緣政治競爭下，大型AI公司如今也成為明顯的攻擊目標。
招募業者Lavinder則指出，即使企業擁有完整的安全團隊，也無法完全避免問題，更無法干涉企業老闆的私人生活。她說：「安全團隊沒有否決權。高階主管想做什麼，終究還是會照自己的意思去做。」
paras_en: As the artificial intelligence (AI) industry expands rapidly, tech companies are actively recruiting talent who have worked for intelligence agencies to guard against espionage, corporate‑secret theft and ransomware threats. The security risk has drawn extra attention after Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged extramarital partner was accused of being a Chinese spy.
Former intelligence officers, recruiting firms and insiders say that chip and tech firms benefiting from soaring AI demand have been continuously expanding their security teams in recent years.

Former US Secret Service agent and current Insite Risk Management president Christopher Falkenberg said, "AI companies are hiring security talent in large numbers. Government agencies have some very specialized people, and they are thinking about how to protect these companies… talent with relevant experience is in short supply."

Nvidia announced on Thursday that founder Jensen Huang will step down, a shock to the company and the entire AI sector. Huang has admitted to one extramarital affair; Nvidia says it does not believe any national‑security or corporate‑secret information was leaked, and China denies any spy‑related accusations.

Counter‑intelligence roles have risen sharply in recent years. Tracking corporate hiring trends, Revelio Labs notes that counter‑intelligence positions are a new phenomenon at leading AI firms, with OpenAI, Anthropic and Nvidia posting increasingly specific jobs that pay roughly $200,000‑$500,000.

Former CIA officer and current Control Risks expert Catherine Marinis‑Yaqub said companies value counter‑intelligence specialists for their ability to spot corporate‑secret theft and threats such as extortion or coercion that exploit senior‑executive vulnerabilities.

She also helps executives identify spies who might try to approach, extort or recruit them in everyday settings like gyms or coffee shops. "Companies are becoming more aware of these risks, but there is still a long way to go," she said.

AI giants also need human intelligence. In June 2024 OpenAI appointed former NSA director Paul Nakasone to its board and safety committee, and is now hiring a senior global security investigations lead, listing counter‑intelligence as a key skill.
In October, OpenAI fired an engineer after a hidden recording device was found behind a conference‑room TV; the engineer accused of installing it now denies any illegal eavesdropping charges.

Rival Anthropic is hiring former CIA deputy director David Cohen and former NSA cyber‑security chief Dave Luber to join its national‑security advisory board. A recent job posting for a threat‑intelligence security engineer described the role as "one of the most coveted targets of nation‑states and high‑level criminal actors worldwide."

Professional recruiter SI Placement founder Kathy Lavinder said the scarcity of such talent drives corporate pay far above the public sector, with top cyber‑security executives earning $1‑$4 million annually, depending on stock awards.

ASML also wants to catch spies, recruiting an intelligence head in Taiwan. Europe's most valuable listed company, ASML (ASML‑US), is bolstering its security defenses to address risks tied to chip‑making equipment in the US‑China tech rivalry.

ASML created an Intelligence Fusion Centre several years ago and is now hiring an intelligence director to be based in Taiwan, home to its biggest customer TSMC (TSM‑TW) (2330‑TW), which manufactures chips for Nvidia.
The job description reads like a spy‑novel role, tasked with uncovering espionage, sabotage and terrorism “internal threats,” and requires at least ten years of counter‑intelligence experience.

ASML declined comment, but public filings show its security staff has grown rapidly over the past decade, and in 2024 it hired Sebastian Reyn, a former deputy director of the Dutch Military Intelligence Service.
The Hague Strategic Research Centre analyst Hans Horan said, "ASML is one of the more mature companies in security‑risk management because it has long been a target of attacks."

Who watches corporate CEOs? Executives’ private lives remain a cyber‑security vulnerability. Former ASML security chief now head of cyber‑security firm CyberAlloy, Aernout Reijmer, says security leaders are focused on AI‑related hacking and data‑protection after AI adoption, potentially overlooking the risk of executives falling into spy traps.
Reijmer noted, "I think 90% of companies completely ignore this risk, because the moment you mention it, everyone immediately thinks of the James Bond theme music."
He added that large tech firms and banks usually have fairly robust defenses, but in the context of global geopolitical competition, big AI companies have become obvious attack targets.

Recruiter Lavinder warned that even with a full security team, firms cannot fully prevent problems nor intervene in CEOs’ private lives. "Security teams have no veto power. Whatever senior executives want to do, they will ultimately do it themselves."

items.title: 〈觀察〉三大台系PCB廠前3季汽車板銷售都突破百億元健鼎仍居冠軍
items.title_en: Observation: The Three Major Taiwanese PCB Makers All Exceeded NT$10 Billion in Automotive Board Sales in the First Three Quarters of 2026, with Kenda Still Leading
paras: 健鼎(3044-TW)自2012年大舉切入汽車板市場以來，健鼎在2023年憑藉高產能的HDI製程擊敗敬鵬(2355-TW)，首度登上台廠汽車板出貨王寶座。同時，依最新財報顯示，2026年前三季包括健鼎、定穎(3715-TW)及敬鵬三大台系汽車板廠出貨金額都突破100億元，合計達342.07億元，其中並以健鼎120.72億元居冠，年增13.43%。
同時，汽車板市場需求已經趨於穩定，但在PCB上游CCL嚴重缺貨的壓抑之下，並已出現向小廠退出的現象，也將使這一區塊的市場更走上強者恒強強的走勢。
就2026年1-9月汽車板市場銷售冠軍的健鼎(3044-TW)來看，雖然網通與伺服器、記憶體模組板仍因AI需求提升而分別居銷售金額前二名，且 網通與伺服器已連續兩個季度占營收比重逾40%，且因營收的的快速成長，使汽車板的營收比重一路逐季下滑。
在2026年第三季健鼎營收306.94億元，通與伺服器板占比達41.2%，記憶體模組板占27.9%，汽車板占比下滑到15.2%，但累計健鼎2026年1-9月汽車板營收以120.72億元居三大汽車板廠之冠，且年增13.43%。
而第二名的定穎在汽車板的比重，在2026年以來則由54%、55%及57%一路攀升，定穎在2026年第三季營收87.05億元創新高，汽車板營收季增33%，營收占比並挺升到57%，也使定穎在2026年第三季單一汽車類別營收達49.52億元，也比健鼎的單46.65億元高。
定穎在2026年1-9月汽車板的營收117.8億元，較2025年同期的85.74億元，則出現37.39%的高幅成長。
而第三名的敬鵬在2026年1-3季營收131.08億元，但敬鵬對產品結構重新分類，對AI基建及航天類別產品獨立爲一類，營收占比爲9%，在汽車電子占比爲62%，同時，在先進駕駛輔助系統（ADAS）及智慧駕艙應用板占比爲19%，合計在汽車應用上占比79%，已經優於2025年2025年全年平均占比的77%。
敬鵬在2026年1-9月汽車板營收達103.55億元，也較2025年同期的85.74億元成長17.1%。
敬鵬2026年1-9月營收131.09億元，毛利率15.21%，年增4.54個百分點，2026年1-3季稅後純益達9.6億元，年增1.52倍，並且超越2025年全年獲利，每股純益達2.42元。
法人看好，敬鵬2026年整體營運可望較去年回升，隨著泰國新廠產能陸續加入，加上公司多年深耕泰國PCB市場、累積成熟的生產經驗，敬鵬在2027年成長動能也備受關注。法人預期，隨著汽車板需求穩健，加上泰國新產能挹注，敬鵬2026年營運可望優於去年，2027年成長表現更值得期待。
由於汽車板市場需求回穩有利敬鵬營收、敬鵬並跨足工業控制電子板逐漸有成，工業電子控制板在今年取得新訂單，業績預估將由今年下半年起走高，同時，敬鵬除在泰國生產基地原廠完成改造投產之外，新建生產大樓的新投資進展順利，預計2027年還有新產能投產，且目前對 CCL成本節節上攀的營運干擾，並已陸續向客戶端反映。
paras_en: Kenda (3044‑TW) entered the automotive board market on a large scale in 2012 and, thanks to its high‑capacity HDI process, beat Jingpeng (2355‑TW) in 2023 to become Taiwan’s top automotive board shipper for the first time. According to the latest financial report, the three major Taiwanese automotive‑board manufacturers—Kenda, Dingying (3715‑TW) and Jingpeng—each shipped over NT$10 billion in the first three quarters of 2026, totalling NT$342.07 billion, with Kenda leading at NT$120.72 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 13.43%.

At the same time, demand for automotive boards has stabilised, but severe shortages of CCL upstream in the PCB supply chain are forcing smaller players to exit, further concentrating the market among the strongest firms.

Looking at Kenda (3044‑TW), the 2026 Q1‑Q3 automotive‑board market champion, its network‑communication, server and memory‑module boards remain the top two revenue sources thanks to rising AI demand. Network‑communication and server boards have accounted for more than 40% of revenue for two consecutive quarters, and the rapid growth of those segments has caused the share of automotive‑board revenue to decline quarter by quarter.

In Q3 2026 Kenda posted revenue of NT$306.94 billion, with network‑communication and server boards making up 41.2%, memory‑module boards 27.9%, and automotive boards falling to 15.2%. Nevertheless, its cumulative automotive‑board revenue of NT$120.72 billion for the year‑to‑date remains the highest among the three manufacturers, up 13.43% year‑over‑year.

The second‑place maker Dingying saw its automotive‑board share rise steadily to 54%, 55% and 57% in 2026. Dingying achieved a record Q3 2026 revenue of NT$87.05 billion, with automotive‑board revenue jumping 33% quarter‑over‑quarter and its share climbing to 57%. This gave Dingying automotive‑board revenue of NT$49.52 billion in Q3, surpassing Kenda’s NT$46.65 billion.
Dingying’s automotive‑board revenue for the first three quarters of 2026 was NT$117.8 billion, compared with NT$85.74 billion in the same period of 2025, a strong 37.39% increase.

The third‑place player Jingpeng recorded NT$131.08 billion in revenue for Q1‑Q3 2026. Jingpeng re‑classified its product mix, separating AI‑infrastructure and aerospace products into a distinct category (9% of revenue). Automotive electronics now account for 62% of revenue, with ADAS and smart‑cabin application boards contributing 19%, bringing the total automotive‑related share to 79%, up from an average of 77% for the full year of 2025.
Jingpeng’s automotive‑board revenue reached NT$103.55 billion in the first three quarters of 2026, up 17.1% from NT$85.74 billion in the same period of 2025.

Jingpeng posted NT$131.09 billion in revenue for Q1‑Q3 2026, with a gross margin of 15.21%, up 4.54 percentage points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax for Q1‑Q3 was NT$9.6 billion, a 1.52‑fold increase over the prior year, surpassing full‑year 2025 earnings, and earnings per share reached NT$2.42.

Institutional investors are optimistic that Jingpeng’s overall 2026 operations will improve over the previous year. With the new Thai plant’s capacity coming online and the company’s long‑standing presence and mature production experience in Thailand’s PCB market, Jingpeng’s growth momentum in 2027 is also drawing attention. Analysts expect that steady automotive‑board demand, bolstered by the new Thai capacity, will make Jingpeng’s 2026 performance better than 2025, with even more promising growth in 2027.

Because automotive‑board demand has stabilised, it benefits Jingpeng’s revenue, and the company’s expansion into industrial‑control electronic boards is gaining traction. New industrial‑control board orders are expected to lift performance from the second half of this year onward. In addition to completing the refurbishment and start‑up of its original Thai production base, Jingpeng’s new manufacturing building is progressing smoothly, with another new capacity slated to come online in 2027. The firm is also actively addressing the rising CCL cost pressures that have been affecting operations, communicating these issues to its customers.

items.title: 台股震盪、企業獲利卻創高！AI三雄營收破紀錄 00961掌握科技金融雙引擎
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Fluctuate, Yet Corporate Profits Hit New Highs! AI Trio Posts Record Revenues, 00961 Leverages Dual Tech and Finance Engines
paras: 台股近期上演急跌急漲行情，市場情緒隨國際政經消息劇烈擺盪，但企業基本面卻傳出截然不同的訊號。台灣10月出口衝上967.6億美元，年增58.9%，創單月歷史新高；台積電 (2330-TW) 10月營收達5,868.9億元，年增59.7%，同步刷新紀錄。隨著上市櫃公司10月營收陸續揭曉，AI伺服器供應鏈出貨暢旺、金融業獲利穩健，為台股中長線行情增添基本面支撐。
富蘭克林華美投信（00961-TW）FT臺灣永續高息經理人江明鴻指出，股市短線難免受到外資籌碼、利率政策與國際事件干擾，但真正決定企業長期價值的，仍是訂單能否轉化為營收、營收能否進一步創造獲利。從最新公布的經濟數據與企業財報觀察，台灣科技產業需求並未因股價震盪而明顯降溫，中長期仍可審慎樂觀看待。
其中，AI伺服器供應鏈表現尤其突出。華碩10月營收達1,076.2億元，年增62.3%，創歷史新高；廣達與緯創同月營收年增率更分別達約104%及117.6%，雙雙繳出翻倍成長成績單。隨著全球雲端服務商持續擴建AI基礎設施，相關訂單逐步轉化為實際出貨，顯示AI投資熱潮正從資本支出承諾，進一步反映在台灣供應鏈營收。
除了科技股成長動能強勁，金融族群也展現獲利韌性。上海商銀前10月累計稅後純益約164.15億元，年增約22%，每股盈餘達3.35元，前十個月獲利已超越去年全年。相較科技股受惠AI設備需求，金融股則可從核心業務與獲利累積提供不同收益來源，成為市場震盪期間值得關注的配置方向。
江明鴻表示，對於希望兼顧資本成長與現金流的投資人而言，高股息ETF不能只比較配息率，更應檢視成分股的獲利能力、產業分布與股利延續性。尤其當市場波動加劇，企業是否具備穩定創造現金流與持續成長的能力，將影響長期投資成果。以00961為例，透過科技成長與金融獲利兩大主軸，參與AI產業擴張及金融業經營成果，降低投資組合對單一產業的依賴。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has recently seen rapid drops and rallies, with market sentiment swinging sharply on international political and economic news, while corporate fundamentals are sending a completely different signal. Taiwan’s October exports surged to $96.76 billion, up 58.9% year‑on‑year, setting a new monthly record; TSMC (2330‑TW) posted October revenue of NT$586.89 billion, up 59.7% year‑on‑year, also a record. As listed companies release their October revenues, strong shipments in the AI server supply chain and solid earnings in the financial sector are adding fundamental support to Taiwan’s medium‑ to long‑term market outlook.

Franklin Templeton (00961‑TW) manager Jiang Ming‑hong of FT Taiwan Sustainable High‑Yield noted that short‑term market moves are inevitably affected by foreign‑capital flows, interest‑rate policy and global events, but the true driver of a company’s long‑term value remains whether orders can be turned into revenue and whether that revenue can generate profit. From the latest economic data and corporate earnings, demand for Taiwan’s tech industry has not cooled noticeably despite stock‑price volatility, allowing a cautiously optimistic medium‑ to long‑term view.

The AI server supply chain stood out in particular. ASUS reported October revenue of NT$107.62 billion, up 62.3% year‑on‑year, a historic high; Quanta and Wistron posted year‑on‑year revenue growth of roughly 104% and 117.6% respectively, both delivering double‑digit growth scores. As global cloud providers continue to expand AI infrastructure, related orders are gradually turning into actual shipments, showing that the AI investment boom is moving from capital‑expenditure commitments to tangible revenue for Taiwan’s supply chain.

Beyond the strong growth momentum in tech stocks, the financial sector also demonstrated earnings resilience. Shanghai Commercial Bank recorded a cumulative after‑tax profit of about NT$16.415 billion for the first ten months of the year, up roughly 22% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of NT$3.35, already surpassing its full‑year profit from the previous year. While tech stocks benefit from AI equipment demand, financial stocks draw from core business and profit accumulation, offering a different source of returns and becoming a noteworthy allocation theme during market turbulence.

Jiang emphasized that investors seeking both capital growth and cash flow should not judge high‑dividend ETFs solely by yield, but also examine the profitability of constituent stocks, sector allocation and dividend sustainability. Especially when market volatility intensifies, a company’s ability to generate stable cash flow and sustain growth will affect long‑term investment outcomes. Using 00961 as an example, its focus on both tech growth and financial earnings allows participation in AI industry expansion and financial sector performance, reducing portfolio reliance on any single industry.

items.title: AI伺服器成PC大廠2027年成長動能 華碩拚高雙位數增長、技嘉擴產搶市
items.title_en: AI Servers to Drive PC Giants' Growth in 2027: Asus Targets Double‑Digit Growth, Gigabyte Expands Production to Capture Market
paras: 台灣個人電腦與板卡品牌大廠華碩(2357-TW)、技嘉(2376-TW)近期召開法說會，釋出最新AI伺服器營運展望與全球產能規劃。三大廠一致看好AI伺服器成為驅動2027年營運成長的核心動能，其中華碩預估2026年第四季伺服器營收季增150%，技嘉則指出AI伺服器訂單能見度已直達2027年底
在具體財務數據與營運展望方面，華碩財務長吳長榮表示，受惠於強勁訂單動能與部分2026年第三季遞延訂單出貨，預估第四季伺服器營收將迎來爆發性增長，單季季增達150%，年增更高達280%。
華碩共同執行長許先越與胡書賓皆強調，儘管第三季有部分資料中心客戶因部署時程延後導致出貨遞延至第四季認列，第三季伺服器營收仍年增100%，占整體品牌營收比重達30%，且全年伺服器營收有信心達成至少150%以上的成長目標。
展望2027年營運表現，華碩共同執行長胡書賓指出，2027年伺服器業務達成雙位數甚至高雙位數年成長相當有把握，內部更以挑戰三位數成長為企圖心。
技嘉集團共同總經理李宜泰同樣表示，目前客戶對AI伺服器訂單需求非常強勁且能見度持續提高，成長動能可望一路延續至2027年底，發言人劉文忠更預期隨經濟規模擴大與費用率優化，2027年營業利益的成長幅度將優於營收成長幅度。
因應客戶強勁需求，技嘉持續調整全球生產布局並擴大資本支出，劉文忠透露2026年資本支出預計約為28至30億元新台幣，2027年資本支出規劃則預估提高至40億元新台幣。
在全球產能配置上，技嘉台灣廠將持續強化產能擴充並支援高階產品製造、工程及系統整合需求，美國廠作為提升北美市場在地供應彈性、加速客戶認證及發揮交付效率的核心，馬來西亞及其他東南亞基地則依客戶需求與供應鏈策略逐步擴充產能。
在伺服器產品線擴展方面，企業客戶為支援AI工作負載而擴建地端資料中心，同步為華碩通用型CPU伺服器帶來顯著帶動效應。胡書賓透露，華碩2026年第三季通用型CPU伺服器營收年增80%，占內部伺服器營收比重已達20%，未來除GPU伺服器外，通用型CPU伺服器也將是積極布局的重點。
至於技嘉2027年新專案來源，劉文忠分析成長動能主要來自整體市場需求擴張、新客戶數量增加，以及針對既有客戶提供涵蓋硬體、軟體與液冷機櫃等更多元的產品方案。
針對外部環境與產業趨勢變化，胡書賓分析近期市場出現資本市場融資條件趨緊與美國期中大選後地方政府對資料中心監管趨嚴兩大變化，可能導致體質不佳的Tier 2與Tier 3雲端服務商或NeoCloud面臨整併與淘汰，促使未來產業更集中於財務穩定、能掌握能源且兼顧環境與社區發展的核心玩家手中，而華碩2026年第四季及2027年已核准的建設案與訂單需求並未遇到延遲。
李宜泰則強調，技嘉在Neocloud客戶盡職調查與風險控制上維持穩健營運品質，並透過維持客戶組合與系統策略彈性控管風險，同時面對未來NVIDIA新管理團隊上任，雙方從管理層到執行面、產品與行銷皆有由上而下的深入合作，整體配合策略不會改變。
paras_en: Taiwan's major PC and motherboard brands Asus (2357‑TW) and Gigabyte (2376‑TW) recently held earnings calls, unveiling their latest AI server operating outlooks and global capacity plans. All three leading companies see AI servers as the core driver of growth through 2027, with Asus forecasting a 150% quarter‑over‑quarter increase in server revenue for Q4 2026 and Gigabyte noting that AI server order visibility extends to the end of 2027.

Regarding specific financial figures and outlook, Asus CFO Wu Chang‑Jung said that strong order momentum and the shipment of some deferred Q3 2026 orders will trigger explosive growth in Q4 server revenue, with a 150% sequential increase and an annual rise of up to 280%.

Asus co‑CEOs Hsu Hsien‑Yue and Hu Shu‑Pin emphasized that, although some data‑center customers delayed deployments and shifted shipments to Q4, Q3 server revenue still grew 100% year‑over‑year, accounting for 30% of total brand revenue, and the company is confident that full‑year server revenue will achieve at least 150% growth.

Looking ahead to 2027 performance, Asus co‑CEO Hu Shu‑Pin said the company is confident of achieving double‑digit, even high double‑digit, annual growth in the server business, and internally is aiming for triple‑digit growth as an ambition.

Gigabyte Group co‑General Manager Li Yi‑Tai also stated that customer demand for AI server orders is very strong and visibility continues to improve, with growth momentum expected to carry through to the end of 2027. Spokesperson Liu Wen‑Chung further projected that, as the economy scales and cost efficiencies improve, 2027 operating profit growth will outpace revenue growth.

In response to strong customer demand, Gigabyte is continuously adjusting its global production layout and expanding capital expenditures. Liu Wen‑Chung disclosed that capital spending for 2026 is expected to be around NT$2.8‑3.0 billion, with a planned increase to NT$4.0 billion in 2027.

Regarding global capacity allocation, Gigabyte’s Taiwan plant will keep strengthening capacity expansion to support high‑end product manufacturing, engineering and system‑integration needs. The U.S. plant serves as the core for enhancing local supply flexibility in North America, accelerating customer certification and delivery efficiency, while the Malaysia and other Southeast Asian sites will gradually expand capacity according to customer demand and supply‑chain strategy.

On the server product line expansion, enterprise customers are building edge data centers to support AI workloads, which in turn significantly boosts Asus’s general‑purpose CPU servers. Hu Shu‑Pin revealed that Asus’s Q3 2026 general‑purpose CPU server revenue grew 80% year‑over‑year, now representing 20% of internal server revenue, and that beyond GPU servers, general‑purpose CPU servers will remain a key focus for future deployment.

As for Gigabyte’s new project sources in 2027, Liu Wen‑Chung analyzed that growth will mainly stem from overall market demand expansion, an increase in new customers, and offering existing customers more diversified solutions covering hardware, software and liquid‑cooling racks.

Addressing external environment and industry trend changes, Hu Shu‑Pin noted two recent shifts: tighter capital‑market financing conditions and stricter post‑midterm‑election data‑center regulations by U.S. local governments. These could force weaker Tier 2 and Tier 3 cloud providers or NeoClouds into consolidation or exit, concentrating the industry around financially stable players with energy control and environmental and community development focus. Asus’s approved construction projects and order demand for Q4 2026 and 2027 have not faced delays.

Li Yi‑Tai emphasized that Gigabyte maintains robust operational quality in NeoCloud customer due diligence and risk control, managing portfolio and system‑strategy flexibility to mitigate risk. He also noted that with NVIDIA’s new management team taking over, both parties will deepen cooperation from leadership to execution, product and marketing, and the overall partnership strategy will remain unchanged.
