items.title: NVIDIA管理層大地震！研調揭AI供應鏈六大觀察 ASIC競爭升溫
items.title_en: NVIDIA Leadership Shakeup! Research Highlights Six AI Supply‑Chain Observations, ASIC Competition Heats Up
paras: NVIDIA 創辦人黃仁勳正式卸下總裁、執行長及董事職務，為全球AI產業投下震撼彈。NVIDIA董事會宣布由財務長Colette Kress接任代理執行長，並啟動新任執行長遴選。研調機構Counterpoint Research指出，這場領導層變動短期內預料不會影響NVIDIA既有晶片產品路線，但中長期新管理團隊的策略方向，將牽動AI基礎建設投資、半導體供應鏈合作及全球AI晶片競爭版圖，台積電、HBM及AI伺服器供應鏈後續動向備受關注。
Counterpoint分析，NVIDIA過去數年透過GPU架構、網路互連及系統平台整合，建立從晶片、先進封裝、記憶體到AI伺服器的完整生態系。相關供應鏈涵蓋台積電先進製程與CoWoS封裝、SK海力士及美光高頻寬記憶體（HBM），以及鴻海、廣達、緯創等伺服器製造商，彼此已形成高度協同的產品開發與交付節奏。
Counterpoint認為，NVIDIA從Blackwell到Vera Rubin的產品規劃已逐步建立，既有研發團隊及供應鏈合作關係，可望支撐未來18至24個月的產品推進，因此短期產品藍圖不至於出現劇烈變化。不過，隨著管理團隊進入交接階段，未來產品更新速度、技術投資及採購策略是否調整，將影響供應商的產能規劃、研發投入與資本支出。
除了產品路線，NVIDIA如何延續既有AI生態系整合優勢，也是市場關注重點。Counterpoint指出，NVIDIA的競爭力早已從GPU延伸至能源、晶片、資料中心基礎設施、AI模型及應用，並透過CUDA軟體平台建立競爭門檻。新管理團隊能否維持跨技術平台整合能力，以及延續與雲端業者、合作夥伴及各國主權AI計畫的合作，將是影響中長期成長的重要因素。
另一方面，AI晶片市場也正面臨新的競爭變化。隨著大型雲端服務供應商（CSP）積極發展自有AI晶片，包括Google TPU及亞馬遜AWS Trainium，市場逐漸形成GPU與客製化特殊應用積體電路（ASIC）並行的發展格局。
Counterpoint Research研究副總監Brady Wang預測，伺服器AI ASIC出貨量將於2027年超越GPU出貨量。NVIDIA領導層變動可能促使部分客戶重新檢視晶片供應商組合，但實際採購仍須考量運算效能、成本、軟體生態系及投資報酬率，並非單純由管理階層異動決定。
此外，AI基礎建設投資除了晶片供應，電力取得及資料中心建置進度也將影響整體部署時程。隨著AI運算資源涉及國家安全與出口管制議題，各國對高效能晶片流向、最終使用者及遠端運算存取的監管也日益受到重視，未來雲端服務供應商、AI基礎設施營運商及通路業者，恐面臨更嚴格的客戶審查與合規要求。
Counterpoint Research共同創辦人暨研究副總裁Neil Shah指出，NVIDIA此次領導層變動為AI產業帶來新的觀察變數，但不代表既有技術發展及市場需求將立即改變。短期市場仍將以產品交付、供應鏈合作及客戶需求為主要驅動力，中長期則須留意新管理團隊的策略方向、AI晶片供應商競爭、客製化ASIC滲透率及全球監管政策演變。
隨著AI產業從高速擴張逐步轉向規模化部署，市場對成本效率及投資報酬率的要求也將提高。NVIDIA在黃仁勳卸任後能否延續原有技術與生態系優勢，以及AI晶片市場是否加速走向多元供應，將成為下一階段產業競爭的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang officially stepped down from his roles as president, chief executive officer and director, delivering a shockwave to the global AI industry. The NVIDIA board announced that CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO and a search for a new chief executive has begun. Counterpoint Research notes that this leadership change is not expected to affect NVIDIA’s existing chip product roadmap in the short term, but the strategic direction of the new management team in the medium to long term will influence AI infrastructure investment, semiconductor supply‑chain partnerships and the global AI chip competitive landscape, drawing close attention to TSMC, HBM and AI server supply‑chain developments.

Counterpoint analysis shows that over the past few years NVIDIA has built a complete ecosystem—from chips, advanced packaging and memory to AI servers—through its GPU architecture, network interconnects and system‑platform integration. The related supply chain includes TSMC’s advanced processes and CoWoS packaging, SK Hynix and Micron high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), as well as server manufacturers such as Foxconn, Quanta and Wistron, which have developed a highly coordinated product development and delivery rhythm.

Counterpoint believes that NVIDIA’s product roadmap from Blackwell to Vera Rubin is already taking shape, and the existing R&D team and supply‑chain partnerships should support product progress for the next 18‑24 months, so the short‑term product blueprint is unlikely to undergo drastic changes. However, as the management team transitions, adjustments to product‑update speed, technology investment and procurement strategy could affect suppliers’ capacity planning, R&D spending and capital expenditures.

Beyond the product line, how NVIDIA maintains its AI ecosystem integration advantage is also a key market focus. Counterpoint points out that NVIDIA’s competitiveness has long extended from GPUs to energy, chips, data‑center infrastructure, AI models and applications, with the CUDA software platform creating a competitive moat. Whether the new leadership can preserve cross‑technology platform integration and continue collaborations with cloud providers, partners and sovereign AI programs worldwide will be crucial for medium‑ to long‑term growth.

On the other hand, the AI chip market is facing new competitive dynamics. Major cloud service providers (CSPs) are actively developing their own AI chips, such as Google’s TPU and Amazon’s AWS Trainium, leading the market toward a parallel development model of GPUs and custom application‑specific integrated circuits (ASICs).

Counterpoint Research senior research director Brady Wang predicts that server AI ASIC shipments will surpass GPU shipments by 2027. The leadership change at NVIDIA may cause some customers to reassess their chip‑supplier mix, but actual procurement will still depend on compute performance, cost, software ecosystem and return on investment, not merely on executive turnover.

Furthermore, AI infrastructure investment involves not only chip supply but also power acquisition and data‑center construction, which will affect overall deployment timelines. As AI computing resources raise national‑security and export‑control concerns, governments are increasingly scrutinizing the flow of high‑performance chips, end‑users and remote‑computing access, meaning cloud providers, AI infrastructure operators and distributors may face stricter customer vetting and compliance requirements in the future.

Counterpoint Research co‑founder and vice‑president of research Neil Shah notes that while this leadership shift introduces new variables for the AI industry, it does not mean existing technology development and market demand will change immediately. In the short term, product delivery, supply‑chain collaboration and customer demand will remain the main drivers, while the medium‑ to long‑term outlook requires watching the new team’s strategic direction, AI chip supplier competition, ASIC penetration and evolving global regulatory policies.

As the AI industry moves from rapid expansion to scaled deployment, demands for cost efficiency and return on investment will rise. Whether NVIDIA can sustain its technological and ecosystem advantages after Huang’s departure, and whether the AI chip market will accelerate toward diversified supply, will be key indicators of the next phase of industry competition.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉外資期貨做空未轉向前 題材股輪動維繫多方熱度
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Foreign Futures Short Positions Remain Unchanged, Thematic Stocks Rotate to Sustain Bullish Momentum
paras: 在台股連4周走跌合計重挫20%後，國安基金宣布進場，使本周加權指數強彈達3973點，收復5日線和10日線短期均線，漲幅達10%，下檔有撐的氣氛逐漸轉強，但又遭逢黃仁勳事件，令來回波動相當大，台股交易員提醒，外資期貨淨空單續增至已超過10萬口，隨著美股有壓，仍要注意短線有獲利者出場造成的壓力，若有行情先以個股或族群表現為主流。
上周加權指數反彈達10%，不過，外資仍賣超968億元與內資投信對作，呈現連7周賣超，主要賣超中鋼(2002-TW)和仁寶(2324-TW)均超過6萬張，力積電(6770-TW)和大成鋼(2027-TW)均逾4.6萬張，英業達(2356-TW)達3.2萬張，廣達(-TW)2.1萬張，元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)近1.9萬張，台積電(2330-TW)和正新(2105-TW)均達1.7萬張。
反觀投信仍維持買超力道，本周主要集中在大型電子股和金控股，有助穩住大盤漲點，一周來買超中信金(2891-TW)近5.4萬張，南亞(1303-TW)4.2萬張，元大台灣50(0050-TW)近3萬張，國泰金(2882-TW)和富邦金(2881-TW)均逾2萬張，元大台灣50正2達1.6萬張，台積電近1.5萬張，台玻(1802-TW)1.2萬張，日月光投控(3711-TW)逾8000張。
台股交易員認為，九合一大選前的選前行情可望使大盤明顯具備下檔支撐，然而美股電子股因黃仁勳事件仍是餘波蕩漾，且大盤在過去一周大漲10%後面臨月線和季線的反壓，較好狀況是先量縮整理、多頭以題材股維持輪動熱度。
永豐投顧指出，加權指數處在月線、季線與半年線下方，月線與季線走勢向下正在形成壓力，均線排列仍未明朗，但是KD 指標上已交叉向上，在此位階很可能盤整；整體而言，短線反彈仍屬跌深後的修復階段，尚未重回多頭結構。
從籌碼面來看，外資 10 月賣超創下歷史單月新高，但在反彈過程卻未出現外資買超回補，從過往經驗來看，新波段的開始往往伴隨外資回補，因此需等外資轉買，加上新台幣止貶回升帶動更多海外資金回流台灣。
paras_en: After four consecutive weeks of declines that wiped out about 20% of the Taiwan index, the National Security Fund announced a buy-in, pushing the weighted index up sharply to 3,973 points this week, recapturing the 5‑day and 10‑day moving averages with a 10% gain. The lower‑level support gradually strengthened, but the market was hit by the Jensen Huang incident, causing large swings. Traders warned that foreign futures net short positions have risen to over 100,000 contracts; with pressure from the U.S. market, short‑term profit‑taking could add further pressure, so any rally may first be led by individual stocks or sector performances.

Last week the weighted index rebounded 10%, yet foreign investors still sold a net NT$96.8 billion, out‑selling domestic institutional investors for seven consecutive weeks. The biggest sells were China Steel (2002‑TW) and Compal (2324‑TW), each over 60,000 lots, followed by Largan Precision (6770‑TW) and Da‑Cheng Steel (2027‑TW) each above 46,000 lots, Inventec (2356‑TW) 32,000 lots, Quanta (‑TW) 21,000 lots, Yuanta Taiwan 50 Plus (00631L‑TW) nearly 19,000 lots, and both TSMC (2330‑TW) and Cheng Shin (2105‑TW) around 17,000 lots each.

Conversely, institutional investors kept net buying, focusing this week on large‑cap electronics and financial stocks, helping to anchor the market’s gains. Over the past week they bought net 54,000 lots of CTBC Financial Holding (2891‑TW), 42,000 lots of Nan Ya (1303‑TW), nearly 30,000 lots of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), over 20,000 lots each of Cathay Financial (2882‑TW) and Fubon Financial (2881‑TW), 16,000 lots of Yuanta Taiwan 50 Plus, about 15,000 lots of TSMC, 12,000 lots of Taiwan Glass (1802‑TW), and more than 8,000 lots of ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW).

A Taiwan market trader believes that the pre‑election rally ahead of the “nine‑in‑one” election could give the index clear lower‑level support. However, U.S. tech stocks are still rattled by the Jensen Huang episode, and after the index’s 10% surge last week it now faces resistance from the monthly and quarterly moving averages. The best scenario is a contraction‑phase consolidation, with bulls keeping thematic‑stock rotation lively.

Yong‑Feng Investment Advisory notes that the weighted index sits below its monthly, quarterly and semi‑annual moving averages, with downward pressure forming on the monthly and quarterly trends. The moving‑average alignment is still unclear, but the KD indicator has already crossed upward, suggesting the market may linger in a sideways range at this level. Overall, the short‑term bounce is still a recovery phase after a deep decline and has not yet returned to a bullish structure.

From a chip‑flow perspective, foreign investors set a historic monthly net‑sell record in October, yet no net buying has appeared during the rebound. Historically, new upward waves often begin when foreign investors start to buy back, so a turn to net buying—combined with the New Taiwan dollar’s halt in depreciation and its subsequent appreciation—could attract more overseas capital back to Taiwan.

items.title: 竣邦Q3純益年增近1倍EPS1.79元創新高 Q4迎旺季訂單需求佳
items.title_en: Junbang Q3 Net Profit Nearly Doubles YoY, EPS NT$1.79 Hits Record High; Q4 Anticipates Strong Seasonal Order Demand
paras: 戶外機能性布料設計廠竣邦-KY(4442-TW)第三季稅後純益5830萬元，年增近1倍，每股純益1.79元，創歷史新高；前三季每股純益4.59元。公司看好，第四季進入旺季，且訂單需求良好，對後市展望樂觀。
竣邦表示，目前觀察品牌客戶訂單及拉貨需求維持良好，訂單能見度優於去年同期，隨著營運規模持續擴大、核心產品出貨成長及產品組合持續優化，對全年獲利表現深具信心，並以挑戰歷史最佳表現為目標。
展望2027年，竣邦表示，隨著主力品牌核心系列產品合作持續深化、新客戶與新應用領域加速拓展，以及越南織染二廠建置穩步推進，成長動能持續增強，將持續朝再創新高的目標邁進。
竣邦第三季營收6.36億元，年增77%，毛利率26%，年減3個百分點；營業利益7310.8萬元，年增100%，營業利益率11%，年增1個百分點；稅後純益5830萬元，年增99%。
竣邦說明，毛利率主要受成本端匯率變動影響，不過，受惠營收規模大幅擴大，單季毛利金額仍較去年同期成長30%。
竣邦前三季累計營收16.45億元，年增35%，毛利率27%，年減1個百分點；營業利益1.88億元，年增38%，營業利益率12%，年增1個百分點；稅後純益1.47億元，年增31%，每股純益4.59元。
竣邦10月營收1.89億元，年增66%；累計前10月營收18.35億元，年增37%，已超越2025年全年水準。
竣邦說明，10月營收成長主要來自近年重點發展的新客戶，隨合作由開發階段進入量產出貨，新客戶採用的產品品項及出貨量同步增加；前10月重點發展新客戶營收較去年同期成長近六成，占整體營收比重約兩成。
竣邦表示，目前新客戶涵蓋高端運動休閒、工裝及袋材等應用領域，在主力品牌之外形成新的營收來源，使公司客戶與產品組合更趨多元。
paras_en: Outdoor functional fabric design company Junbang-KY (4442-TW) posted a Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$58.3 million, up almost 100% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.79, a historic high; the EPS for the first three quarters was NT$4.59. The company is optimistic, noting that Q4 enters the peak season and order demand is strong, supporting a positive outlook.

Junbang said it currently sees brand‑client orders and pull‑forward demand remaining healthy, with order visibility better than the same period last year. As operating scale continues to expand, core product shipments grow and the product mix keeps improving, the company is confident about full‑year profitability and aims to challenge its best historical performance.

Looking ahead to 2027, Junbang said that as collaborations on core series products with major brands deepen, new customers and application areas expand rapidly, and the construction of its second weaving‑dyeing plant in Vietnam progresses steadily, growth momentum will keep strengthening, driving the company toward new record highs.

In Q3, Junbang recorded revenue of NT$636 million, up 77% YoY, with a gross margin of 26%, down 3 percentage points year‑over‑year; operating profit was NT$73.108 million, up 100% YoY, yielding an operating margin of 11%, up 1 percentage point; after‑tax net profit was NT$58.3 million, up 99% YoY.

Junbang explained that the gross margin was mainly affected by currency fluctuations on the cost side, but thanks to the large increase in revenue scale, the gross profit amount for the quarter still grew 30% compared with the same period last year.

For the first three quarters, Junbang’s cumulative revenue reached NT$1.645 billion, up 35% YoY, with a gross margin of 27%, down 1 percentage point; operating profit was NT$188 million, up 38% YoY, giving an operating margin of 12%, up 1 percentage point; after‑tax net profit was NT$147 million, up 31% YoY, with EPS of NT$4.59.
Junbang reported October revenue of NT$189 million, up 66% YoY; cumulative revenue for the first ten months was NT$1.835 billion, up 37% YoY, already surpassing the full‑year level of 2025.

Junbang said the October revenue growth mainly stemmed from newly developed key customers in recent years; as cooperation moved from development to mass production, the product items and shipment volumes from these new customers increased in tandem. Revenue from these key new customers in the first ten months grew nearly 60% YoY, accounting for about 20% of total revenue.

Junbang noted that its new customers now cover high‑end sports‑leisure, workwear and bag‑material applications, creating additional revenue streams beyond its core brands and making the company’s customer base and product portfolio more diversified.

items.title: 黃仁勳離職《大賣空》貝瑞再加碼放空科技股！警告AI熱潮或陷入「牛市陷阱」
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's Resignation Prompts Michael Burry to Deepen Tech Short Bets, Warning AI Hype May Be a Bull‑Market Trap
paras: 隨著輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳離職令科技股前景蒙上陰影，知名投資人、電影《大賣空》原型人物貝瑞（Michael Burry）再度加碼放空科技股，認為人工智慧（AI）熱潮可能正形成一場「牛市陷阱」。他將那斯達克100指數近期高點比擬為2000年網路泡沫破裂前的市場頂峰，並押注晶片股及整體科技板塊將在2027年年中前出現顯著修正。
貝瑞在Substack最新文章中，以「見證牛市陷阱」（Behold the bull-trap）為題，引用那斯達克100指數10月6日觸及的階段性高點，認為市場可能已在不知不覺中見頂。
他將當前市場情勢與2000年3月網路泡沫高峰相提並論，當時科技股估值大幅偏離基本面，隨後引發長期市場崩跌。
貝瑞進一步透露，已於11月12日趁那斯達克100指數反彈至27,000點之際，將相關看跌期權部位加碼至原先的兩倍，履約日期設定在2027年初，目前履約價格約低於指數現價20%。
此外，他也重新建立先前已平倉的VanEck半導體指數VanEck Vectors 半導體 ETF(SMH-US) 看跌期權部位。

黃仁勳離職成看空催化劑 點名輝達及AI雲端業者

輝達執行長黃仁勳離職的消息，進一步強化貝瑞對科技股的看空立場。他在Substack針對此事發文，直接建議投資人「離場」，認為領導層更替將對輝達的獲利率及成長動能造成負面影響，衝擊也可能沿著AI產業鏈擴散。
貝瑞隨後進一步列出他認為可能受到波及的企業，特別是與輝達關係密切、共同參與AI基礎設施建置及融資的業者，包括新興雲端運算服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 與Nebius(NBIS-US) ，兩家公司都是輝達GPU的大型客戶。
貝瑞指出，這些企業組成的投資組合過去一個月經歷劇烈波動，過去均深度受惠於輝達的市場主導地位及資源外溢效應，但如今產業似乎正進入新的局面。
他表示，自己正在尋找輝達市場影響力明顯減弱的跡象。

放空策略轉向半導體ETF 押注2027年產業鏈修正

值得注意的是，貝瑞近幾個月已調整放空策略。根據他10月披露的布局，其空頭部位已從先前針對輝達及Palantir(PLTR-US) 等個股的押注，轉向更廣泛的市場指數，主要透過VanEck半導體ETF看跌期權布局。
黃仁勳離職消息傳出後，這項策略也更聚焦於半導體產業鏈。由於輝達與台積電(2330-TW) 均為VanEck半導體ETF的最大持股，兩家公司的前景不確定性，也成為貝瑞看空該ETF的重要依據。
整體而言，貝瑞仍維持原先判斷，認為晶片股估值過高，並預期半導體及整體科技產業將在2027年迎來一波顯著修正。
paras_en: As Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang steps down, casting a shadow over tech‑stock outlooks, famed investor and the real‑life inspiration for the film "The Big Short," Michael Burry is once again increasing his short exposure to tech equities, arguing that the AI frenzy could be turning into a "bull‑market trap." He likens the recent Nasdaq‑100 peak to the market top before the 2000 dot‑com bust and bets that chip stocks and the broader tech sector will see a sharp correction before mid‑2027.
In a new Substack post titled "Behold the bull‑trap," Burry points to the Nasdaq‑100’s interim high reached on October 6 as evidence that the market may have quietly topped out.
He draws a parallel between today’s conditions and the March 2000 dot‑com peak, when tech valuations had strayed far from fundamentals and subsequently triggered a prolonged market decline.

Burry disclosed that on November 12, as the Nasdaq‑100 rebounded to about 27,000 points, he doubled his bearish options position, setting expirations for early 2027 with strike prices roughly 20% below the current index level.
He also re‑established a previously closed short position in put options on the VanEck Vectors Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US).

Huang’s departure is a catalyst for Burry’s bearish stance. In his Substack note he urges investors to "exit," arguing that a leadership change will hurt Nvidia’s margins and growth momentum, with fallout likely to spread along the AI supply chain.

Burry then listed firms he believes could be hit, especially those closely tied to Nvidia and involved in building and financing AI infrastructure, such as emerging cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (NBIS‑US), both large Nvidia GPU customers.

He noted that the portfolio of these companies has experienced extreme volatility over the past month, having previously benefited heavily from Nvidia’s market dominance and spill‑over effects, but now the industry appears to be entering a new phase.
He said he is looking for signs that Nvidia’s market influence is waning.

It is noteworthy that Burry has shifted his short strategy in recent months. According to his October disclosures, his bearish bets have moved from individual stocks like Nvidia and Palantir (PLTR‑US) to broader market indices, primarily through put options on the VanEck Semiconductor ETF.

After news of Huang’s resignation, the strategy has become even more focused on the semiconductor supply chain. Since Nvidia and Taiwan Semiconductor (2330‑TW) are the largest holdings in the VanEck Semiconductor ETF, uncertainty around both companies underpins Burry’s short case on the ETF.
Overall, Burry sticks to his original view that chip stocks are overvalued and expects a significant correction in the semiconductor and broader tech sectors by 2027.

items.title: 馬斯克力挺黃仁勳！稱輝達少了他恐失「關鍵交易」：許多合作只靠握手承諾
items.title_en: Musk Backs Jensen Huang! Says Nvidia Would Lose “Key Deals” Without Him: Many Collaborations Rely Only on Handshake Promises
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克周六（14日）在社群平台 X 發文表示，若輝達(NVDA-US) 現已遭撤換的執行長黃仁勳不再掌舵，公司將失去一些「關鍵」交易。
馬斯克指出，黃仁勳在輝達供應鏈管理方面表現「出色」，但許多重要交易其實是「與黃仁勳本人握手達成的協議，而非白紙黑字的合約」。
他表示：「少了黃仁勳，輝達至少會失去部分這類關鍵交易。」
馬斯克隨後也補充說：「如果黃仁勳向我承諾會交付運算資源，或我請他加快零組件供貨速度，他總是說到做到。當然，我們之後某個時間點還是會補上採購訂單，但我從來沒有一刻懷疑過這些承諾不會兌現。」
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk posted on X on Saturday (the 14th) that if Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang, who has now been removed, no longer leads the company, it will lose some “key” deals.

Musk pointed out that Huang has performed “outstandingly” in managing Nvidia’s supply chain, but many important deals are actually “agreements reached by shaking hands with Huang himself, rather than written contracts on paper.”
He said: “Without Jensen Huang, Nvidia will at least lose a portion of these kinds of key deals.”

Musk added: “If Jensen Huang promises me delivery of compute resources, or I ask him to speed up component supply, he always follows through. Of course, we will later place the purchase orders, but I have never once doubted that these promises would be fulfilled.”

items.title: 輝達間諜風暴敲響警鐘！AI圈重金延攬前情報官 頂尖資安主管薪酬上看400萬美元
items.title_en: Nvidia Spy Storm Sounds Alarm! AI Industry Lavishes on Former Intelligence Officers, Top Cybersecurity Executives Earn Up to $4 Million
paras: 隨著人工智慧(AI)產業快速擴張，科技公司正積極延攬曾在情報機構任職的人才，以防範間諜活動、商業機密竊取及勒索威脅。在輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳婚外情對象被指控是中國間諜，讓這項安全風險格外受關注。
前情報官員、招募業者及企業內部人士指出，近年受惠於AI需求大幅成長的晶片及科技公司，正持續擴編安全團隊。
前美國特勤局探員、現任Insite Risk Management總裁Christopher Falkenberg說：「AI公司已大量延攬安全人才。政府部門有一些非常專業的人才，正在思考如何保障這些企業的安全……具備相關經驗的人才供不應求。」
輝達本周四宣布，創辦人黃仁勳將卸下職務，消息震撼公司及整個AI產業。黃仁勳已承認其中一段婚外情，輝達表示不認為國家安全或企業機密因此外洩，中國則否認間諜活動相關指控。

反情報職務近年明顯增加

追蹤企業招募趨勢的Revelio Labs指出，反情報職缺是前沿AI公司近年才出現的新現象，OpenAI、Anthropic及輝達等公司陸續刊登更明確的相關職位，薪資多介於20萬至50萬美元。
前中央情報局(CIA)官員、現任策略風險與安全顧問公司Control Risks專家Catherine Marinis-Yaqub表示，企業看重反情報專家辨識商業機密竊取，以及有人透過企業高層的弱點進行勒索或脅迫等威脅的能力。
她也協助企業高層辨識健身房、咖啡店等日常場合中，可能試圖接近、勒索或招募他們的間諜。她說：「企業開始更加意識到這些風險，但還有很長一段路要走。」

AI巨頭也需要人類情報

OpenAI於2024年6月任命前美國國家安全局(NSA)局長Paul Nakasone加入董事會及安全委員會，目前也正招募一名資深全球安全調查主管，把反情報列為重要技能之一。
OpenAI今年10月解雇一名工程師，原因是在高層會議室的電視後方發現隱藏錄音裝置，但這名遭控安裝裝置的工程師目前否認非法竊聽的指控。
競爭對手Anthropic則在延攬前CIA副局長David Cohen及前NSA網路安全主管Dave Luber，加入該公司的國家安全顧問委員會。近期一則招募威脅情報安全工程師的資訊中，自述是「全球最受民族國家及高階犯罪分子覬覦的目標之一」。
專業招募公司SI Placement創辦人Kathy Lavinder表示，相關人才稀有，使企業薪酬遠高於公部門，企業界的頂尖資安主管每年薪酬可達100萬至400萬美元，視股票獎酬而定。

ASML也要抓間諜 在台招募情報主管

歐洲市值最高的上市公司艾司摩爾(ASML-US)也加強安全防禦，以因應晶片製造設備技術在美中科技競爭中的風險。
ASML前幾年就成立「情報融合中心」(Intelligence Fusion Centre)，目前正在招募派駐台灣的情報主管。台灣是最大客戶台積電(TSM-TW)(2330-TW)的所在地，而台積電為輝達生產晶片。
招聘資訊描述的工作內容，宛如間諜小說中的角色，任務是揪出間諜活動、破壞及恐怖主義等「內部威脅」，應徵者須具備至少10年反情報工作經驗。
ASML拒絕對此置評，但公開文件顯示，該公司的安全部門人力在過去10年間快速增加，2024年更聘用了曾任荷蘭軍事情報局副局長的Sebastian Reyn。
海牙戰略研究中心分析師Hans Horan說：「ASML是安全風險管理方面較為成熟的企業之一，因為它一直是攻擊目標。」

誰來監視企業老闆？高層私生活仍是資安漏洞

曾任ASML安全主管、現為網路安全合作公司CyberAlloy負責人的Aernout Reijmer表示，資安主管目前優先處理AI駭客攻擊及企業採用AI後的資料保護，卻可能因此忽略企業高層落入間諜陷阱的風險。
Reijmer說：「我認為有90%的企業完全忽略這項風險，因為只要一提到這件事，大家腦中馬上就會響起《007》電影的主題曲。」
他指出，大型科技公司及銀行通常已建立相當完善的防禦機制，但在全球地緣政治競爭下，大型AI公司如今也成為明顯的攻擊目標。
招募業者Lavinder則指出，即使企業擁有完整的安全團隊，也無法完全避免問題，更無法干涉企業老闆的私人生活。她說：「安全團隊沒有否決權。高階主管想做什麼，終究還是會照自己的意思去做。」
paras_en: As the artificial intelligence (AI) industry expands rapidly, tech companies are actively recruiting talent who have worked for intelligence agencies to guard against espionage, corporate‑secret theft and ransomware threats. The security risk has drawn extra attention after Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged extramarital partner was accused of being a Chinese spy.
Former intelligence officers, recruiting firms and insiders say that chip and tech firms benefiting from soaring AI demand have been continuously expanding their security teams in recent years.

Former US Secret Service agent and current Insite Risk Management president Christopher Falkenberg said, "AI companies are hiring security talent in large numbers. Government agencies have some very specialized people, and they are thinking about how to protect these companies… talent with relevant experience is in short supply."

Nvidia announced on Thursday that founder Jensen Huang will step down, a shock to the company and the entire AI sector. Huang has admitted to one extramarital affair; Nvidia says it does not believe any national‑security or corporate‑secret information was leaked, and China denies any spy‑related accusations.

Counter‑intelligence roles have risen sharply in recent years. Tracking corporate hiring trends, Revelio Labs notes that counter‑intelligence positions are a new phenomenon at leading AI firms, with OpenAI, Anthropic and Nvidia posting increasingly specific jobs that pay roughly $200,000‑$500,000.

Former CIA officer and current Control Risks expert Catherine Marinis‑Yaqub said companies value counter‑intelligence specialists for their ability to spot corporate‑secret theft and threats such as extortion or coercion that exploit senior‑executive vulnerabilities.

She also helps executives identify spies who might try to approach, extort or recruit them in everyday settings like gyms or coffee shops. "Companies are becoming more aware of these risks, but there is still a long way to go," she said.

AI giants also need human intelligence. In June 2024 OpenAI appointed former NSA director Paul Nakasone to its board and safety committee, and is now hiring a senior global security investigations lead, listing counter‑intelligence as a key skill.
In October, OpenAI fired an engineer after a hidden recording device was found behind a conference‑room TV; the engineer accused of installing it now denies any illegal eavesdropping charges.

Rival Anthropic is hiring former CIA deputy director David Cohen and former NSA cyber‑security chief Dave Luber to join its national‑security advisory board. A recent job posting for a threat‑intelligence security engineer described the role as "one of the most coveted targets of nation‑states and high‑level criminal actors worldwide."

Professional recruiter SI Placement founder Kathy Lavinder said the scarcity of such talent drives corporate pay far above the public sector, with top cyber‑security executives earning $1‑$4 million annually, depending on stock awards.

ASML also wants to catch spies, recruiting an intelligence head in Taiwan. Europe's most valuable listed company, ASML (ASML‑US), is bolstering its security defenses to address risks tied to chip‑making equipment in the US‑China tech rivalry.

ASML created an Intelligence Fusion Centre several years ago and is now hiring an intelligence director to be based in Taiwan, home to its biggest customer TSMC (TSM‑TW) (2330‑TW), which manufactures chips for Nvidia.
The job description reads like a spy‑novel role, tasked with uncovering espionage, sabotage and terrorism “internal threats,” and requires at least ten years of counter‑intelligence experience.

ASML declined comment, but public filings show its security staff has grown rapidly over the past decade, and in 2024 it hired Sebastian Reyn, a former deputy director of the Dutch Military Intelligence Service.
The Hague Strategic Research Centre analyst Hans Horan said, "ASML is one of the more mature companies in security‑risk management because it has long been a target of attacks."

Who watches corporate CEOs? Executives’ private lives remain a cyber‑security vulnerability. Former ASML security chief now head of cyber‑security firm CyberAlloy, Aernout Reijmer, says security leaders are focused on AI‑related hacking and data‑protection after AI adoption, potentially overlooking the risk of executives falling into spy traps.
Reijmer noted, "I think 90% of companies completely ignore this risk, because the moment you mention it, everyone immediately thinks of the James Bond theme music."
He added that large tech firms and banks usually have fairly robust defenses, but in the context of global geopolitical competition, big AI companies have become obvious attack targets.

Recruiter Lavinder warned that even with a full security team, firms cannot fully prevent problems nor intervene in CEOs’ private lives. "Security teams have no veto power. Whatever senior executives want to do, they will ultimately do it themselves."

items.title: 黃仁勳走後誰來當「AI央行」？逾5,300億美元承諾與擔保面臨考驗
paras: 過去幾年，輝達(NVDA-US) 不僅是人工智慧（AI）產業的晶片供應商，也透過大規模投資、融資與擔保，成為支撐整個AI產業鏈的重要資金來源。如今，隨著輝達前執行長黃仁勳離開執行長職位，這套由他主導的資本布局能否延續，成為市場關注焦點。
截至7月26日，輝達股權投資帳面價值已達990億美元，投資範圍涵蓋AI研究機構、新興雲端服務商、客戶及上游供應商。其中，對OpenAI的300億美元投資規模最大。此外，輝達也與Groq達成約200億美元的授權交易，並計畫以129億美元收購AI開源平台Hugging Face。
由於部分獲得輝達投資的企業，後續也成為輝達晶片的採購客戶，使公司同時扮演資金提供者與晶片供應商的角色，因此被外界稱為「AI央行」。
股權投資還不是全部。根據截至7月26日的資料，輝達未來在晶片採購、雲端服務、資料中心租賃及算力回購等方面的承諾，加上各類擔保上限，總額約達5,305億美元。
其中，晶片及產能採購承諾約2,790億美元，另包括為OpenAI俄亥俄州資料中心提供的1,050億美元擔保。

黃仁勳離開後　AI產業鏈融資恐出現空窗

黃仁勳離職後，市場開始重新評估輝達持續為AI產業鏈提供資金的能力與意願。
根據外媒13日報導，高盛分析師James Schneider在黃仁勳辭職後發布研究報告，維持輝達「買進」評級，但將目標價從300美元下調至220美元。
Schneider預期，輝達仍會履行所有已宣布的承諾，但認為少了黃仁勳的遠見、影響力與號召力，公司未來要再次促成同等規模、涉及多方的合作投資，難度將會提高。
他指出，輝達股價過去相較大盤出現明顯折價，其中一項原因是投資人擔心，一旦輝達等企業停止提供融資，AI基礎設施的成長速度可能大幅放緩。
瑞銀分析師Tim Arcuri也將融資視為黃仁勳離職後最可能受到影響的領域。他認為，即使新任領導團隊延續既有策略，輝達短期內推動這類交易的意願與能力仍可能出現「停頓」。
瑞銀估計，輝達每季自由現金流有很大一部分重新投入AI產業鏈。若相關資金流動暫停，整個生態系可能至少暫時失去超過500億美元的資金支持，而目前正值利率上升、部分信貸市場流動性收緊之際。
投行William Blair分析師Sebastien Naji則認為，已簽署的合約不會因執行長更替而受到影響，真正面臨風險的是下一輪交易。他指出，到了2027年及之後，輝達的市場占有率可能面臨博通(AVGO-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 等競爭對手更大的挑戰。
報導也指出，已有一家雲端服務商因黃仁勳離職帶來的不確定性，重新考慮改用Google(GOOGL-US) 或超微半導體的晶片。
輝達提供的擔保之所以重要，在於部分借款企業本身信用條件不佳。對於持續燒錢的AI研究機構及規模較小的雲端服務商而言，若只憑自身信用，往往難以取得低成本融資；有了輝達這家大型企業提供擔保，放款機構才更願意以較低利率提供資金。
不過，AI算力融資市場原本就已出現壓力。澳洲AI雲端服務商Firmus今年10月撤回首次公開發行（IPO）計畫，CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 的歐元債券目前交易價格也僅約面額的八成。
美國金融服務公司Raymond James私募資本諮詢全球主管Sunaina Sinha Haldea表示，黃仁勳離職讓交易各方有理由重新檢視合約條款。
她認為，資金不會因此撤離市場，但放款方可能因不確定性要求更高報酬，也會更嚴格追問風險究竟由誰承擔。這類檢視將擴及整個AI基礎設施融資市場。

5,000億美元融資平台遲未啟動　25%擔保比例成爭議

除了既有投資與擔保，輝達另一項融資布局也面臨進展不如預期的問題。
據悉，黃仁勳今年8月與六家華爾街資產管理機構共同推出規模5,000億美元的AI融資平台，至今已過三個月，仍未完成任何一筆交易。
這項計畫原本希望協助企業以GPU作為抵押品借款，取得購買晶片所需資金，輝達則承諾承擔其中最高1,250億美元的風險。
交易遲遲未能推進，關鍵在於輝達承諾的擔保比例。分析指出，若抵押GPU價格下跌導致貸款出現損失，輝達最多只會承擔每筆交易25%的風險。不過，過去一個月，部分客戶及華爾街合作夥伴要求提高擔保比例，原因是競爭對手博通提供的風險承擔力度更大。
博通今年5月曾為Anthropic一筆350億美元的債務交易提供300億美元擔保，目前也正為另一筆630億美元的交易提供約72.5%、相當於430億美元的擔保。
報導指出，輝達最早可能於明年1月宣布該融資平台的首筆交易，但黃仁勳離職後，這項時程能否如期實現仍有待觀察。目前輝達與六家資產管理機構簽署的仍是初步合作意向，正式協議尚未敲定。

Kress接掌投資與擔保決策　過去曾對交易提出質疑

隨著黃仁勳離開，輝達投資及擔保決策的主導權落在財務長、現任臨時執行長克雷斯（Colette Kress）手中。外媒報導指出，Kress過去對這類交易一向較為審慎。
在黃仁勳主導擴大融資布局期間，Kress曾針對交易篩選方式、擔保估值及投資報酬率提出疑問，也曾試圖在幕後限制由黃仁勳女婿Nico Caprez主導的融資計畫。
報導並指出，OpenAI俄亥俄州資料中心計畫的條款曾由Kress重新調整，將輝達最初承諾的規模削減一半。
今年8月的一場內部會議上，黃仁勳曾在Kress報告期間打斷她，形容她就像「車燈前的小鹿」（a deer in the headlights），意指受到驚嚇而不知所措。
然而，Kress並非全盤反對輝達的投資與融資策略。她8月下旬曾公開為相關交易辯護，表示：「我們知道有人會稱之為循環融資，但我們看法不同。」她並認為，這些投資將帶來非常出色的報酬。
分析指出，從相關報導來看，Kress的審慎態度主要體現在交易條件與風險控管，而非否定輝達透過投資及融資擴大AI生態系的整體策略。
輝達預計於美東時間11月17日公布第三季財報，這也是Kress首次以臨時執行長身分面對市場。5,000億美元融資平台的推進情況，以及未來擔保政策是否調整，預料將成為分析師關注的焦點。

items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab開放個人訂購 售價3萬美元
items.title_en: Tesla Opens Personal Orders for Cybercab at $30,000
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 宣布向受邀客戶開放Cybercab訂購用於「個人用途」，售價約3萬美元，客戶需要支付1,000美元訂金，且必須訂閱每月299美元自動駕駛服務。
首批交付預定將於12月開始，但初期範圍僅限於美國德州5座城市以及指定區域。
特斯拉執行長馬斯克表示，隨著監管審批陸續通過，Cybercab將逐步向全美用戶開放。
不過，他也表示，每月299美元訂閱費用「太高了」，定價應與特斯拉其他車型上FSD及聯網服務費用相當，即每月約115美元。
馬斯克上周曾說，Cybercab未來還會實現一系列效率提升，使電池組容量能降至40kWh。特斯拉還會採用液態銀作為車身顏色，讓整體色彩不會過於單調。
馬斯克重申，Cybercab生產優先級高於Cybertruck。「如果我們必須維持Cybertruck複雜的產線和供應鏈，並為其持續投入工程技術人員，那麼這些人才、工廠和設備就無法用於擴大Cybercab產能。而Cybercab才是真正能夠徹底改變全球陸地交通運輸格局的車型。」
Cybercab作為特斯拉Robotaxi車隊未來主力，配備剪刀門（又稱蝴蝶門），車內沒方向盤、沒油門和剎車踏板，也沒後視鏡。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) announced that invited customers can now order the Cybercab for personal use at a price of about $30,000, with a $1,000 deposit required and a mandatory $299 per month autonomous driving subscription.
The first deliveries are slated to begin in December, initially limited to five cities in Texas and designated areas within the state.
CEO Elon Musk said that as regulatory approvals come through, the Cybercab will be gradually opened to users across the United States.

However, he also noted that the $299 monthly subscription fee is "too high" and should be priced similarly to Tesla's other models' Full Self‑Driving and connectivity services, roughly $115 per month.

Musk said last week that the Cybercab will eventually incorporate a series of efficiency improvements, reducing battery pack capacity to 40 kWh, and will use liquid silver as a body color to avoid a monotonous appearance.

Musk reiterated that Cybercab production takes priority over the Cybertruck, stating that if resources remain tied to the complex Cybertruck production line and its engineering staff, those people, factories, and equipment cannot be used to expand Cybercab capacity, and that Cybercab is the model that can truly transform global land transportation.

The Cybercab, envisioned as the future backbone of Tesla's robotaxi fleet, features scissor (butterfly) doors and an interior without a steering wheel, accelerator or brake pedals, and no rear‑view mirrors.

items.title: 輝達醜聞使美商務部長盧特尼克面臨下台危機！《巴隆》恐牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與政府投資
items.title_en: Nvidia Scandal Puts US Commerce Secretary Lutnick in Danger of Ouster! Barron's May Influence Steel, Crypto and Government Investments
paras: 美國商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）因輝達(NVDA-US) 相關爭議遭到政府內外批評，傳出可能面臨去職危機。這場風波不僅牽涉美國對中國的晶片出口管制，也可能影響美國貿易政策、政府入股民間企業的布局，以及鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融等產業。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，爭議焦點在於，盧特尼克未將新加坡企業Megaspeed列入美國限制名單。該公司涉嫌協助將輝達先進晶片轉運至中國，藉此規避美國出口管制。
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週五（13日）接受《CNBC》訪問時，將矛頭指向商務部，批評該部門未將Megaspeed列入限制名單，導致該公司仍能取得美國技術。
盧特尼克預計將就此事赴參議院銀行委員會作證。預測市場Kalshi的交易者則估計，他今年卸任的機率達58%。
這起爭議也與輝達執行長黃仁勳本週辭職，以及他承認對妻子不忠的消息交織。此前有報導指出，黃仁勳曾與Megaspeed一名前高階主管黃樂（Alice Huang）發生婚外情，而美國正調查該名人士是否與中國情報機構有所關聯。

盧特尼克去留牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融業

盧特尼克曾任金融服務公司Cantor Fitzgerald負責人，是川普在貿易談判、加密貨幣政策及華爾街相關議題上的重要幕僚，也主導美國政府擴大直接持有民間企業股權的政策。
Beacon Policy Advisors分析師Tedford指出，近幾個月盧特尼克介入美國與加拿大、墨西哥的貿易談判，力圖避免鋼鐵及鋁材關稅在更廣泛的貿易協議中遭到削弱。
這項立場有利於Cleveland-Cliffs與諾可(NUE-US) 等美國鋼鐵業者，兩家公司高層都曾將關稅視為支撐產業的重要因素。
在加密貨幣領域，盧特尼克同樣是產業支持者之一。去年，川普政府指派他等內閣官員研究如何增加政府持有的加密貨幣，配合川普提出的「戰略比特幣儲備」計畫；今年夏季國會審議有利加密貨幣產業的法案期間，他也曾與業者高層會面。
此外，盧特尼克與美國聯邦住房金融局（FHFA）局長普爾特（Bill Pulte）均支持出售房貸金融巨頭房利美（Fannie Mae）及房地美（Freddie Mac）部分股權。
報導指出，如果盧特尼克不再主掌商務部，上述三個產業的投資人可能面臨更高風險。

輝達風波恐讓美國政府入股企業政策加速

盧特尼克也是川普政府推動入股民間企業政策的主要設計者之一。不過，輝達風波未必會讓這項政策降溫，反而可能促使政府進一步擴大投資。
根據美國外交關係協會（CFR）資料，自2025年1月以來，美國政府已宣布49筆交易，涉及股權投資總額達308億美元，其中包括取得英特爾(INTC-US) 近10%股權。
Raymond James分析師Ed Mills指出，這些投資中有許多是為了降低美國對中國稀土及關鍵礦物供應的依賴。如果輝達醜聞促使川普對中國採取更強硬的立場，中國可能以限制稀土出貨作為反制，讓這類投資變得更加重要。
Mills表示，美中緊張局勢升高，「將加大美國建立自主供應鏈的壓力，也提高美國進一步加碼投資相關企業的可能性」。
paras_en: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is facing criticism from both inside and outside the government over a Nvidia (NVDA-US) controversy, with reports that he may be at risk of removal. The fallout involves US chip export controls on China and could affect US trade policy, government equity stakes in private firms, as well as the steel, cryptocurrency and mortgage finance sectors.

According to Barron’s Weekly, the dispute centers on Lutnick’s failure to place Singapore‑based Megaspeed on the US restricted entities list. The firm is alleged to have helped ship advanced Nvidia chips to China, thereby evading US export controls.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Friday the 13th that the Commerce Department bears responsibility for not adding Megaspeed to the restricted list, allowing the company to continue accessing US technology.
Lutnick is expected to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on the matter. Kalshi market traders estimate his chance of stepping down this year at 58%.

The controversy is intertwined with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation this week and his admission of infidelity. Earlier reports said Huang had an affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, and US investigators are probing whether she has ties to Chinese intelligence agencies.

Lutnick’s fate could affect steel, crypto and mortgage finance. He previously ran Cantor Fitzgerald, served as a key adviser to Trump on trade talks, crypto policy and Wall Street issues, and led the push for expanded government equity stakes in private companies.

Beacon Policy Advisors analyst Tedford noted that in recent months Lutnick has been involved in US‑Canada‑Mexico trade negotiations, seeking to prevent steel and aluminium tariffs from being weakened in broader trade deals.
That stance benefits US steelmakers such as Cleveland‑Cliffs and Nucor (NUE-US), whose executives have long viewed tariffs as a cornerstone of industry support.

In the crypto space, Lutnick is also a supporter. Last year the Trump administration tasked him and other cabinet members with studying how to increase government‑held crypto as part of Trump’s proposed “strategic Bitcoin reserve” plan; this summer, during congressional debate on crypto‑friendly legislation, he met with senior industry leaders.
Lutnick and FHFA Director Bill Pulte have both backed the sale of portions of mortgage giants Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to private investors.
The report warns that if Lutnick leaves the Commerce Department, investors in those three sectors could face heightened risk.
The Nvidia scandal could accelerate the government’s policy of taking equity stakes in private firms.

Lutnick was a chief architect of the Trump administration’s push for government equity in private companies, but the Nvidia episode may not cool the policy; it could instead spur further expansion of government investment.

According to the Council on Foreign Relations, since January 2025 the US government has announced 49 transactions involving a total of $30.8 billion in equity investments, including a near‑10% stake in Intel (INTC-US).

Raymond James analyst Ed Mills said many of those investments aim to reduce US reliance on Chinese rare‑earths and critical minerals, and if the Nvidia scandal pushes Trump to adopt a tougher stance on China, Beijing could retaliate by restricting rare‑earth shipments, making such investments even more vital.

items.title: GLP-1減重藥太貴保險難負擔 CVS：月費降至350美元才有機會打平
items.title_en: GLP-1 Weight‑Loss Drugs Too Expensive for Insurers; CVS Says Monthly Price Must Drop Below $350 to Break Even
paras: 2026年11月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ GLP-1減重藥有助改善患者健康，也可能減少後續住院及急診支出，但高昂藥價仍讓美國企業健康保險難以全面給付。美國醫療保健集團CVS Health(CVS-US)最新研究估算，若GLP-1藥物每月價格降至350美元以下，保險計畫因患者減少就醫而節省的醫療費用，才有機會抵銷新增藥費。
目前藥費距離這個門檻還有一段差距。美國員工福利研究所（EBRI）2025年估計，企業雇主及其他健康保險計畫支付的GLP-1藥物淨成本，約為每人每30天617至766美元，高於CVS估算的350美元。CVS並未透露旗下保險計畫實際支付的平均價格。
CVS追蹤約4,000名持續使用GLP-1藥物三年的患者，發現每人三年累計醫療費用比未用藥的相似患者少9,400美元，但處方藥支出卻多出13,300美元。兩者相抵後，保險計畫平均仍須多負擔3,900美元。
也就是說，保險計畫替患者支付藥費後，雖然可能因患者較少住院或急診而省下部分醫療費用，但節省金額仍不足以彌補藥費增加。CVS估算，若每月藥價降至350美元以下，節省的醫療費用才有機會抵銷藥費，讓企業擴大給付更符合成本效益。
CVS這項研究使用旗下Aetna健康保險的理賠資料，比較2023年至2025年間開始使用GLP-1藥物的患者，以及健康條件相近但未使用藥物的族群，最長追蹤三年。研究涵蓋肥胖、糖尿病及其他疾病患者，使用藥物包括禮來Eli Lilly(LLY-US)的Mounjaro、Zepbound，以及諾和諾德Novo Nordisk(NVO-US)的Ozempic、Wegovy。
藥費能否抵銷，也與患者原本的健康狀況有關。CVS首席醫療長Amy Compton-Phillips指出，住院風險較高的患者，若用藥後減少重大醫療事件，保險計畫可能較快看到費用節省效果；原本健康風險較低的患者，則可能需要更長時間，才能抵銷持續用藥的成本。
研究也發現，使用GLP-1藥物與較少的急診及住院次數有關。由於這是觀察性研究，尚無法直接證明醫療支出下降完全由藥物造成，且未單獨公布肥胖患者的結果。
CVS預計於11月15日在美國HLTH醫療產業大會發表研究結果。對美國企業雇主及健康保險業者而言，未來是否擴大GLP-1給付範圍，除了藥物療效，還須衡量藥價、患者健康風險及長期使用成本。

paras_en: November 14, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – GLP-1 weight‑loss drugs improve patient health and could reduce future hospital and emergency‑room costs, but their high price makes it difficult for U.S. corporate health insurers to cover them fully. CVS Health’s latest study estimates that only if the monthly price falls below $350 will the medical‑cost savings from fewer doctor visits offset the added drug expense.

The price is still far above that threshold. The Employee Benefit Research Institute (EBRI) projected that in 2025 corporate employers and other health plans will pay a net cost of $617‑$766 per person per 30 days for GLP‑1 drugs, well above CVS’s $350 estimate. CVS did not disclose the actual average price its plans pay.

CVS tracked about 4,000 patients who continuously used GLP‑1 drugs for three years and found that each person’s total medical costs over three years were $9,400 lower than similar patients who did not use the drugs, but prescription drug spending was $13,300 higher. After offsetting the two, insurers still had to shoulder an average extra $3,900 per member.

In other words, even after insurers pay for the medication, the savings from fewer hospitalizations or ER visits are not enough to cover the higher drug cost. CVS estimates that only if the monthly price drops below $350 will the saved medical expenses have a chance to offset the drug cost, making broader coverage more cost‑effective for companies.

The study used claims data from CVS’s Aetna health insurance, comparing patients who started GLP‑1 therapy between 2023 and 2025 with a matched cohort who did not use the drugs, with follow‑up up to three years. The analysis covered patients with obesity, diabetes and other conditions, using drugs such as Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro and Zepbound and Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic and Wegovy.

Whether drug costs can be offset also depends on patients’ baseline health. CVS chief medical officer Amy Compton‑Phillips said that high‑risk patients who avoid major medical events after treatment may show cost‑savings more quickly, whereas lower‑risk patients may take longer for the savings to outweigh the ongoing drug expense.

The research also found that GLP‑1 use was associated with fewer ER visits and hospital admissions. Because this is an observational study, it cannot prove that the reduction in medical spending is solely caused by the drugs, and results for obesity‑only patients were not reported separately.

CVS plans to present the findings at the HLTH conference in the United States on November 15. For corporate employers and health insurers, decisions about expanding GLP‑1 coverage will have to weigh not only efficacy but also price, patient health risk and long‑term cost.

items.title: Anthropic推Claude自託管代理！企業可將AI管理系統部署內部、降低雲端調度資安疑慮
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Managed Agents for Self‑Hosted Deployment, Enabling Enterprises to Run AI Management Systems Internally and Reduce Cloud Security Concerns
paras: Anthropic推出自託管版Claude託管代理（Claude Managed Agents），讓企業能將人工智慧（AI）代理的完整管理系統部署在自有私有雲或實體機房，不必再依賴Anthropic雲端伺服器調度任務。這項功能目前已開放私人測試，主要鎖定需要讓AI深入企業內部系統執行工作的用戶，協助解決核心程式碼與內部伺服器存取權限所帶來的資安疑慮。
隨著AI代理逐漸從對話工具轉向執行任務，應用範圍已延伸至程式碼修正、自動化部署與測試、監控警報分流，以及系統缺陷處理等工作。這類任務往往需要AI取得企業內部程式碼及伺服器的存取權限，也讓企業面臨新的安全與合規挑戰。
Anthropic過去提供的折衷方案，是讓企業在本地端執行虛擬沙箱，但代理的調度系統仍運作於Anthropic雲端。
新推出的自託管模式則進一步將調度伺服器、會話資料庫及執行沙箱都交由企業自行部署，使整套系統能在企業內部環境運作。

三層架構分工　任務調度、執行與資料儲存各自獨立

這套系統主要由三個部分組成。首先是調度伺服器，負責接收業務請求、維持代理的運作流程，以及分派各項任務，但不會直接執行程式碼或終端指令。
其次是執行沙箱與工人程序，負責接收調度伺服器下達的任務，並在獨立隔離環境中執行終端指令、讀取檔案及修改程式碼。每個沙箱都相當於獨立的工作環境，讓實際操作與任務調度分開。
第三部分則是資料庫。系統要求搭配企業自有的PostgreSQL資料庫，將代理設定、對話內容及歷史紀錄儲存在企業自己的硬碟中，即使調度伺服器重新啟動，也不會因此遺失過往的會話狀態。
至於哪些資料仍會離開企業內部網路，主要是在代理向大型語言模型（LLM）發出請求時，調度伺服器會將當下的對話脈絡及工具執行結果傳送至模型服務端。
企業也能依照自身合規需求選擇模型服務來源，包括Anthropic官方服務、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) AWS Bedrock、Google(GOOGL-US) Cloud、微軟(MSFT-US) Foundry，或自行架設的模型閘道。

三組密鑰分開管理　沙箱遭入侵也難以取得模型憑證

為避免權限集中造成風險，系統設計三種不同用途的密鑰。第一種是本地伺服器介面密鑰，供企業內部應用程式及管理工具使用，向自有調度伺服器下達指令。
第二種是模型呼叫憑證，僅保存在調度伺服器內部，用於連接遠端大型語言模型，執行沙箱中的工人程序無法取得這組憑證。
第三種是環境專屬密鑰，提供各個沙箱內的工人程序使用，讓它們能向本地調度伺服器取得所屬環境的任務。
透過這種權限分離設計，即使執行沙箱遭到入侵，攻擊者也無法直接取得調用大型語言模型所需的憑證。
不過，Anthropic也特別提醒，這套系統並不會自動替工人程序提供完整的安全防護。內建命令列工具具有實際系統權限，代理可以執行真正的終端指令，因此安全性完全取決於企業部署的沙箱環境。
Anthropic建議，企業應將工人程序放在一次性容器或虛擬機器中執行，任務完成後即予以銷毀。若直接在正式環境伺服器上執行，一旦代理發生誤操作，就可能對實際系統造成破壞。
這也代表，企業雖然能藉由自託管模式取得更高的系統控制權，但同時必須自行負責安全隔離、權限管理及資安稽核。
目前這套系統支援Linux及搭載蘋果(AAPL-US) 晶片的macOS環境。企業用戶可透過Anthropic業務團隊申請取得安裝套件與技術文件。
paras_en: Anthropic has introduced Claude Managed Agents, a self‑hosted version of its Claude AI agents, allowing enterprises to deploy the full AI‑agent management system on private clouds or on‑premises data centers instead of relying on Anthropic’s cloud servers for task scheduling. The feature is currently in private beta and targets users who need AI to operate deep within corporate systems, addressing security concerns around core code and internal server access.

As AI agents shift from conversational tools to task execution, their use cases now include code fixing, automated deployment and testing, alert routing, and system defect handling. These tasks often require the AI to access internal codebases and servers, presenting new security and compliance challenges for companies.
Anthropic’s previous compromise was to let enterprises run a virtual sandbox locally while the agent scheduling system still operated in Anthropic’s cloud.

The new self‑hosted mode pushes the scheduling server, conversation database, and execution sandbox all onto the enterprise’s own infrastructure, allowing the entire system to run inside the corporate environment.

The architecture is split into three layers—task scheduling, execution, and data storage—each operating independently. The scheduling server receives business requests, maintains the agent workflow, and dispatches tasks, but it does not execute code or terminal commands directly.

The execution layer consists of sandboxes and worker processes that receive tasks from the scheduler and run terminal commands, read files, and modify code within isolated environments. Each sandbox functions as a separate work environment, keeping actual execution separate from scheduling.

The third component is the database. The system requires the enterprise’s own PostgreSQL instance to store agent configurations, conversation content, and history on the company’s disks, ensuring that a scheduler restart does not lose prior session state.

Data that leaves the corporate network is limited to the context and tool results sent to the large language model (LLM) when the agent makes a request; the scheduling server forwards this information to the model service endpoint.

Enterprises can choose the model service source to meet compliance needs, including Anthropic’s own service, Amazon (AMZN‑US) AWS Bedrock, Google (GOOGL‑US) Cloud, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) Foundry, or a self‑hosted model gateway.
Three separate keys are managed to avoid centralized risk. The first is a local server interface key used by internal applications and management tools to issue commands to the on‑premises scheduler.
The second is a model‑call credential stored only inside the scheduler for connecting to remote LLMs; worker processes in the sandbox cannot access this credential.
The third is an environment‑specific key provided to each sandbox’s worker processes so they can retrieve tasks from the local scheduler for their own environment.
With this permission‑separation design, even if a sandbox is compromised, attackers cannot obtain the credentials needed to invoke the LLM.

Anthropic cautions that the system does not automatically provide full security for worker processes. Built‑in command‑line tools have real system privileges, and agents can execute genuine terminal commands, so security depends entirely on the sandbox environment the enterprise deploys.

Anthropic recommends running worker processes in disposable containers or virtual machines that are destroyed after task completion. Executing agents directly on production servers risks real‑world damage if the agent misbehaves.
Thus, while self‑hosting gives enterprises greater control, they must also assume responsibility for isolation, permission management, and security auditing.

The system currently supports Linux and macOS environments powered by Apple (AAPL‑US) silicon. Enterprise customers can request installation packages and technical documentation through Anthropic’s sales team.

items.title: 黃仁勳離職《大賣空》貝瑞再加碼放空科技股！警告AI熱潮或陷入「牛市陷阱」
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's Resignation Prompts Michael Burry to Deepen Tech Short Bets, Warning AI Hype May Be a Bull‑Market Trap
paras: 隨著輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳離職令科技股前景蒙上陰影，知名投資人、電影《大賣空》原型人物貝瑞（Michael Burry）再度加碼放空科技股，認為人工智慧（AI）熱潮可能正形成一場「牛市陷阱」。他將那斯達克100指數近期高點比擬為2000年網路泡沫破裂前的市場頂峰，並押注晶片股及整體科技板塊將在2027年年中前出現顯著修正。
貝瑞在Substack最新文章中，以「見證牛市陷阱」（Behold the bull-trap）為題，引用那斯達克100指數10月6日觸及的階段性高點，認為市場可能已在不知不覺中見頂。
他將當前市場情勢與2000年3月網路泡沫高峰相提並論，當時科技股估值大幅偏離基本面，隨後引發長期市場崩跌。
貝瑞進一步透露，已於11月12日趁那斯達克100指數反彈至27,000點之際，將相關看跌期權部位加碼至原先的兩倍，履約日期設定在2027年初，目前履約價格約低於指數現價20%。
此外，他也重新建立先前已平倉的VanEck半導體指數VanEck Vectors 半導體 ETF(SMH-US) 看跌期權部位。

黃仁勳離職成看空催化劑 點名輝達及AI雲端業者

輝達執行長黃仁勳離職的消息，進一步強化貝瑞對科技股的看空立場。他在Substack針對此事發文，直接建議投資人「離場」，認為領導層更替將對輝達的獲利率及成長動能造成負面影響，衝擊也可能沿著AI產業鏈擴散。
貝瑞隨後進一步列出他認為可能受到波及的企業，特別是與輝達關係密切、共同參與AI基礎設施建置及融資的業者，包括新興雲端運算服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 與Nebius(NBIS-US) ，兩家公司都是輝達GPU的大型客戶。
貝瑞指出，這些企業組成的投資組合過去一個月經歷劇烈波動，過去均深度受惠於輝達的市場主導地位及資源外溢效應，但如今產業似乎正進入新的局面。
他表示，自己正在尋找輝達市場影響力明顯減弱的跡象。

放空策略轉向半導體ETF 押注2027年產業鏈修正

值得注意的是，貝瑞近幾個月已調整放空策略。根據他10月披露的布局，其空頭部位已從先前針對輝達及Palantir(PLTR-US) 等個股的押注，轉向更廣泛的市場指數，主要透過VanEck半導體ETF看跌期權布局。
黃仁勳離職消息傳出後，這項策略也更聚焦於半導體產業鏈。由於輝達與台積電(2330-TW) 均為VanEck半導體ETF的最大持股，兩家公司的前景不確定性，也成為貝瑞看空該ETF的重要依據。
整體而言，貝瑞仍維持原先判斷，認為晶片股估值過高，並預期半導體及整體科技產業將在2027年迎來一波顯著修正。
paras_en: As Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang steps down, casting a shadow over tech‑stock outlooks, famed investor and the real‑life inspiration for the film "The Big Short," Michael Burry is once again increasing his short exposure to tech equities, arguing that the AI frenzy could be turning into a "bull‑market trap." He likens the recent Nasdaq‑100 peak to the market top before the 2000 dot‑com bust and bets that chip stocks and the broader tech sector will see a sharp correction before mid‑2027.
In a new Substack post titled "Behold the bull‑trap," Burry points to the Nasdaq‑100’s interim high reached on October 6 as evidence that the market may have quietly topped out.
He draws a parallel between today’s conditions and the March 2000 dot‑com peak, when tech valuations had strayed far from fundamentals and subsequently triggered a prolonged market decline.

Burry disclosed that on November 12, as the Nasdaq‑100 rebounded to about 27,000 points, he doubled his bearish options position, setting expirations for early 2027 with strike prices roughly 20% below the current index level.
He also re‑established a previously closed short position in put options on the VanEck Vectors Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US).

Huang’s departure is a catalyst for Burry’s bearish stance. In his Substack note he urges investors to "exit," arguing that a leadership change will hurt Nvidia’s margins and growth momentum, with fallout likely to spread along the AI supply chain.

Burry then listed firms he believes could be hit, especially those closely tied to Nvidia and involved in building and financing AI infrastructure, such as emerging cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (NBIS‑US), both large Nvidia GPU customers.

He noted that the portfolio of these companies has experienced extreme volatility over the past month, having previously benefited heavily from Nvidia’s market dominance and spill‑over effects, but now the industry appears to be entering a new phase.
He said he is looking for signs that Nvidia’s market influence is waning.

It is noteworthy that Burry has shifted his short strategy in recent months. According to his October disclosures, his bearish bets have moved from individual stocks like Nvidia and Palantir (PLTR‑US) to broader market indices, primarily through put options on the VanEck Semiconductor ETF.

After news of Huang’s resignation, the strategy has become even more focused on the semiconductor supply chain. Since Nvidia and Taiwan Semiconductor (2330‑TW) are the largest holdings in the VanEck Semiconductor ETF, uncertainty around both companies underpins Burry’s short case on the ETF.
Overall, Burry sticks to his original view that chip stocks are overvalued and expects a significant correction in the semiconductor and broader tech sectors by 2027.

items.title: 馬斯克力挺黃仁勳！稱輝達少了他恐失「關鍵交易」：許多合作只靠握手承諾
items.title_en: Musk Backs Jensen Huang! Says Nvidia Would Lose “Key Deals” Without Him: Many Collaborations Rely Only on Handshake Promises
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克周六（14日）在社群平台 X 發文表示，若輝達(NVDA-US) 現已遭撤換的執行長黃仁勳不再掌舵，公司將失去一些「關鍵」交易。
馬斯克指出，黃仁勳在輝達供應鏈管理方面表現「出色」，但許多重要交易其實是「與黃仁勳本人握手達成的協議，而非白紙黑字的合約」。
他表示：「少了黃仁勳，輝達至少會失去部分這類關鍵交易。」
馬斯克隨後也補充說：「如果黃仁勳向我承諾會交付運算資源，或我請他加快零組件供貨速度，他總是說到做到。當然，我們之後某個時間點還是會補上採購訂單，但我從來沒有一刻懷疑過這些承諾不會兌現。」
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk posted on X on Saturday (the 14th) that if Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang, who has now been removed, no longer leads the company, it will lose some “key” deals.

Musk pointed out that Huang has performed “outstandingly” in managing Nvidia’s supply chain, but many important deals are actually “agreements reached by shaking hands with Huang himself, rather than written contracts on paper.”
He said: “Without Jensen Huang, Nvidia will at least lose a portion of these kinds of key deals.”

Musk added: “If Jensen Huang promises me delivery of compute resources, or I ask him to speed up component supply, he always follows through. Of course, we will later place the purchase orders, but I have never once doubted that these promises would be fulfilled.”

items.title: 輝達間諜風暴敲響警鐘！AI圈重金延攬前情報官 頂尖資安主管薪酬上看400萬美元
items.title_en: Nvidia Spy Storm Sounds Alarm! AI Industry Lavishes on Former Intelligence Officers, Top Cybersecurity Executives Earn Up to $4 Million
paras: 隨著人工智慧(AI)產業快速擴張，科技公司正積極延攬曾在情報機構任職的人才，以防範間諜活動、商業機密竊取及勒索威脅。在輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳婚外情對象被指控是中國間諜，讓這項安全風險格外受關注。
前情報官員、招募業者及企業內部人士指出，近年受惠於AI需求大幅成長的晶片及科技公司，正持續擴編安全團隊。
前美國特勤局探員、現任Insite Risk Management總裁Christopher Falkenberg說：「AI公司已大量延攬安全人才。政府部門有一些非常專業的人才，正在思考如何保障這些企業的安全……具備相關經驗的人才供不應求。」
輝達本周四宣布，創辦人黃仁勳將卸下職務，消息震撼公司及整個AI產業。黃仁勳已承認其中一段婚外情，輝達表示不認為國家安全或企業機密因此外洩，中國則否認間諜活動相關指控。

反情報職務近年明顯增加

追蹤企業招募趨勢的Revelio Labs指出，反情報職缺是前沿AI公司近年才出現的新現象，OpenAI、Anthropic及輝達等公司陸續刊登更明確的相關職位，薪資多介於20萬至50萬美元。
前中央情報局(CIA)官員、現任策略風險與安全顧問公司Control Risks專家Catherine Marinis-Yaqub表示，企業看重反情報專家辨識商業機密竊取，以及有人透過企業高層的弱點進行勒索或脅迫等威脅的能力。
她也協助企業高層辨識健身房、咖啡店等日常場合中，可能試圖接近、勒索或招募他們的間諜。她說：「企業開始更加意識到這些風險，但還有很長一段路要走。」

AI巨頭也需要人類情報

OpenAI於2024年6月任命前美國國家安全局(NSA)局長Paul Nakasone加入董事會及安全委員會，目前也正招募一名資深全球安全調查主管，把反情報列為重要技能之一。
OpenAI今年10月解雇一名工程師，原因是在高層會議室的電視後方發現隱藏錄音裝置，但這名遭控安裝裝置的工程師目前否認非法竊聽的指控。
競爭對手Anthropic則在延攬前CIA副局長David Cohen及前NSA網路安全主管Dave Luber，加入該公司的國家安全顧問委員會。近期一則招募威脅情報安全工程師的資訊中，自述是「全球最受民族國家及高階犯罪分子覬覦的目標之一」。
專業招募公司SI Placement創辦人Kathy Lavinder表示，相關人才稀有，使企業薪酬遠高於公部門，企業界的頂尖資安主管每年薪酬可達100萬至400萬美元，視股票獎酬而定。

ASML也要抓間諜 在台招募情報主管

歐洲市值最高的上市公司艾司摩爾(ASML-US)也加強安全防禦，以因應晶片製造設備技術在美中科技競爭中的風險。
ASML前幾年就成立「情報融合中心」(Intelligence Fusion Centre)，目前正在招募派駐台灣的情報主管。台灣是最大客戶台積電(TSM-TW)(2330-TW)的所在地，而台積電為輝達生產晶片。
招聘資訊描述的工作內容，宛如間諜小說中的角色，任務是揪出間諜活動、破壞及恐怖主義等「內部威脅」，應徵者須具備至少10年反情報工作經驗。
ASML拒絕對此置評，但公開文件顯示，該公司的安全部門人力在過去10年間快速增加，2024年更聘用了曾任荷蘭軍事情報局副局長的Sebastian Reyn。
海牙戰略研究中心分析師Hans Horan說：「ASML是安全風險管理方面較為成熟的企業之一，因為它一直是攻擊目標。」

誰來監視企業老闆？高層私生活仍是資安漏洞

曾任ASML安全主管、現為網路安全合作公司CyberAlloy負責人的Aernout Reijmer表示，資安主管目前優先處理AI駭客攻擊及企業採用AI後的資料保護，卻可能因此忽略企業高層落入間諜陷阱的風險。
Reijmer說：「我認為有90%的企業完全忽略這項風險，因為只要一提到這件事，大家腦中馬上就會響起《007》電影的主題曲。」
他指出，大型科技公司及銀行通常已建立相當完善的防禦機制，但在全球地緣政治競爭下，大型AI公司如今也成為明顯的攻擊目標。
招募業者Lavinder則指出，即使企業擁有完整的安全團隊，也無法完全避免問題，更無法干涉企業老闆的私人生活。她說：「安全團隊沒有否決權。高階主管想做什麼，終究還是會照自己的意思去做。」
paras_en: As the artificial intelligence (AI) industry expands rapidly, tech companies are actively recruiting talent who have worked for intelligence agencies to guard against espionage, corporate‑secret theft and ransomware threats. The security risk has drawn extra attention after Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged extramarital partner was accused of being a Chinese spy.
Former intelligence officers, recruiting firms and insiders say that chip and tech firms benefiting from soaring AI demand have been continuously expanding their security teams in recent years.

Former US Secret Service agent and current Insite Risk Management president Christopher Falkenberg said, "AI companies are hiring security talent in large numbers. Government agencies have some very specialized people, and they are thinking about how to protect these companies… talent with relevant experience is in short supply."

Nvidia announced on Thursday that founder Jensen Huang will step down, a shock to the company and the entire AI sector. Huang has admitted to one extramarital affair; Nvidia says it does not believe any national‑security or corporate‑secret information was leaked, and China denies any spy‑related accusations.

Counter‑intelligence roles have risen sharply in recent years. Tracking corporate hiring trends, Revelio Labs notes that counter‑intelligence positions are a new phenomenon at leading AI firms, with OpenAI, Anthropic and Nvidia posting increasingly specific jobs that pay roughly $200,000‑$500,000.

Former CIA officer and current Control Risks expert Catherine Marinis‑Yaqub said companies value counter‑intelligence specialists for their ability to spot corporate‑secret theft and threats such as extortion or coercion that exploit senior‑executive vulnerabilities.

She also helps executives identify spies who might try to approach, extort or recruit them in everyday settings like gyms or coffee shops. "Companies are becoming more aware of these risks, but there is still a long way to go," she said.

AI giants also need human intelligence. In June 2024 OpenAI appointed former NSA director Paul Nakasone to its board and safety committee, and is now hiring a senior global security investigations lead, listing counter‑intelligence as a key skill.
In October, OpenAI fired an engineer after a hidden recording device was found behind a conference‑room TV; the engineer accused of installing it now denies any illegal eavesdropping charges.

Rival Anthropic is hiring former CIA deputy director David Cohen and former NSA cyber‑security chief Dave Luber to join its national‑security advisory board. A recent job posting for a threat‑intelligence security engineer described the role as "one of the most coveted targets of nation‑states and high‑level criminal actors worldwide."

Professional recruiter SI Placement founder Kathy Lavinder said the scarcity of such talent drives corporate pay far above the public sector, with top cyber‑security executives earning $1‑$4 million annually, depending on stock awards.

ASML also wants to catch spies, recruiting an intelligence head in Taiwan. Europe's most valuable listed company, ASML (ASML‑US), is bolstering its security defenses to address risks tied to chip‑making equipment in the US‑China tech rivalry.

ASML created an Intelligence Fusion Centre several years ago and is now hiring an intelligence director to be based in Taiwan, home to its biggest customer TSMC (TSM‑TW) (2330‑TW), which manufactures chips for Nvidia.
The job description reads like a spy‑novel role, tasked with uncovering espionage, sabotage and terrorism “internal threats,” and requires at least ten years of counter‑intelligence experience.

ASML declined comment, but public filings show its security staff has grown rapidly over the past decade, and in 2024 it hired Sebastian Reyn, a former deputy director of the Dutch Military Intelligence Service.
The Hague Strategic Research Centre analyst Hans Horan said, "ASML is one of the more mature companies in security‑risk management because it has long been a target of attacks."

Who watches corporate CEOs? Executives’ private lives remain a cyber‑security vulnerability. Former ASML security chief now head of cyber‑security firm CyberAlloy, Aernout Reijmer, says security leaders are focused on AI‑related hacking and data‑protection after AI adoption, potentially overlooking the risk of executives falling into spy traps.
Reijmer noted, "I think 90% of companies completely ignore this risk, because the moment you mention it, everyone immediately thinks of the James Bond theme music."
He added that large tech firms and banks usually have fairly robust defenses, but in the context of global geopolitical competition, big AI companies have become obvious attack targets.

Recruiter Lavinder warned that even with a full security team, firms cannot fully prevent problems nor intervene in CEOs’ private lives. "Security teams have no veto power. Whatever senior executives want to do, they will ultimately do it themselves."

items.title: 黃仁勳走後誰來當「AI央行」？逾5,300億美元承諾與擔保面臨考驗
paras: 過去幾年，輝達(NVDA-US) 不僅是人工智慧（AI）產業的晶片供應商，也透過大規模投資、融資與擔保，成為支撐整個AI產業鏈的重要資金來源。如今，隨著輝達前執行長黃仁勳離開執行長職位，這套由他主導的資本布局能否延續，成為市場關注焦點。
截至7月26日，輝達股權投資帳面價值已達990億美元，投資範圍涵蓋AI研究機構、新興雲端服務商、客戶及上游供應商。其中，對OpenAI的300億美元投資規模最大。此外，輝達也與Groq達成約200億美元的授權交易，並計畫以129億美元收購AI開源平台Hugging Face。
由於部分獲得輝達投資的企業，後續也成為輝達晶片的採購客戶，使公司同時扮演資金提供者與晶片供應商的角色，因此被外界稱為「AI央行」。
股權投資還不是全部。根據截至7月26日的資料，輝達未來在晶片採購、雲端服務、資料中心租賃及算力回購等方面的承諾，加上各類擔保上限，總額約達5,305億美元。
其中，晶片及產能採購承諾約2,790億美元，另包括為OpenAI俄亥俄州資料中心提供的1,050億美元擔保。

黃仁勳離開後　AI產業鏈融資恐出現空窗

黃仁勳離職後，市場開始重新評估輝達持續為AI產業鏈提供資金的能力與意願。
根據外媒13日報導，高盛分析師James Schneider在黃仁勳辭職後發布研究報告，維持輝達「買進」評級，但將目標價從300美元下調至220美元。
Schneider預期，輝達仍會履行所有已宣布的承諾，但認為少了黃仁勳的遠見、影響力與號召力，公司未來要再次促成同等規模、涉及多方的合作投資，難度將會提高。
他指出，輝達股價過去相較大盤出現明顯折價，其中一項原因是投資人擔心，一旦輝達等企業停止提供融資，AI基礎設施的成長速度可能大幅放緩。
瑞銀分析師Tim Arcuri也將融資視為黃仁勳離職後最可能受到影響的領域。他認為，即使新任領導團隊延續既有策略，輝達短期內推動這類交易的意願與能力仍可能出現「停頓」。
瑞銀估計，輝達每季自由現金流有很大一部分重新投入AI產業鏈。若相關資金流動暫停，整個生態系可能至少暫時失去超過500億美元的資金支持，而目前正值利率上升、部分信貸市場流動性收緊之際。
投行William Blair分析師Sebastien Naji則認為，已簽署的合約不會因執行長更替而受到影響，真正面臨風險的是下一輪交易。他指出，到了2027年及之後，輝達的市場占有率可能面臨博通(AVGO-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 等競爭對手更大的挑戰。
報導也指出，已有一家雲端服務商因黃仁勳離職帶來的不確定性，重新考慮改用Google(GOOGL-US) 或超微半導體的晶片。
輝達提供的擔保之所以重要，在於部分借款企業本身信用條件不佳。對於持續燒錢的AI研究機構及規模較小的雲端服務商而言，若只憑自身信用，往往難以取得低成本融資；有了輝達這家大型企業提供擔保，放款機構才更願意以較低利率提供資金。
不過，AI算力融資市場原本就已出現壓力。澳洲AI雲端服務商Firmus今年10月撤回首次公開發行（IPO）計畫，CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 的歐元債券目前交易價格也僅約面額的八成。
美國金融服務公司Raymond James私募資本諮詢全球主管Sunaina Sinha Haldea表示，黃仁勳離職讓交易各方有理由重新檢視合約條款。
她認為，資金不會因此撤離市場，但放款方可能因不確定性要求更高報酬，也會更嚴格追問風險究竟由誰承擔。這類檢視將擴及整個AI基礎設施融資市場。

5,000億美元融資平台遲未啟動　25%擔保比例成爭議

除了既有投資與擔保，輝達另一項融資布局也面臨進展不如預期的問題。
據悉，黃仁勳今年8月與六家華爾街資產管理機構共同推出規模5,000億美元的AI融資平台，至今已過三個月，仍未完成任何一筆交易。
這項計畫原本希望協助企業以GPU作為抵押品借款，取得購買晶片所需資金，輝達則承諾承擔其中最高1,250億美元的風險。
交易遲遲未能推進，關鍵在於輝達承諾的擔保比例。分析指出，若抵押GPU價格下跌導致貸款出現損失，輝達最多只會承擔每筆交易25%的風險。不過，過去一個月，部分客戶及華爾街合作夥伴要求提高擔保比例，原因是競爭對手博通提供的風險承擔力度更大。
博通今年5月曾為Anthropic一筆350億美元的債務交易提供300億美元擔保，目前也正為另一筆630億美元的交易提供約72.5%、相當於430億美元的擔保。
報導指出，輝達最早可能於明年1月宣布該融資平台的首筆交易，但黃仁勳離職後，這項時程能否如期實現仍有待觀察。目前輝達與六家資產管理機構簽署的仍是初步合作意向，正式協議尚未敲定。

Kress接掌投資與擔保決策　過去曾對交易提出質疑

隨著黃仁勳離開，輝達投資及擔保決策的主導權落在財務長、現任臨時執行長克雷斯（Colette Kress）手中。外媒報導指出，Kress過去對這類交易一向較為審慎。
在黃仁勳主導擴大融資布局期間，Kress曾針對交易篩選方式、擔保估值及投資報酬率提出疑問，也曾試圖在幕後限制由黃仁勳女婿Nico Caprez主導的融資計畫。
報導並指出，OpenAI俄亥俄州資料中心計畫的條款曾由Kress重新調整，將輝達最初承諾的規模削減一半。
今年8月的一場內部會議上，黃仁勳曾在Kress報告期間打斷她，形容她就像「車燈前的小鹿」（a deer in the headlights），意指受到驚嚇而不知所措。
然而，Kress並非全盤反對輝達的投資與融資策略。她8月下旬曾公開為相關交易辯護，表示：「我們知道有人會稱之為循環融資，但我們看法不同。」她並認為，這些投資將帶來非常出色的報酬。
分析指出，從相關報導來看，Kress的審慎態度主要體現在交易條件與風險控管，而非否定輝達透過投資及融資擴大AI生態系的整體策略。
輝達預計於美東時間11月17日公布第三季財報，這也是Kress首次以臨時執行長身分面對市場。5,000億美元融資平台的推進情況，以及未來擔保政策是否調整，預料將成為分析師關注的焦點。

items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab開放個人訂購 售價3萬美元
items.title_en: Tesla Opens Personal Orders for Cybercab at $30,000
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 宣布向受邀客戶開放Cybercab訂購用於「個人用途」，售價約3萬美元，客戶需要支付1,000美元訂金，且必須訂閱每月299美元自動駕駛服務。
首批交付預定將於12月開始，但初期範圍僅限於美國德州5座城市以及指定區域。
特斯拉執行長馬斯克表示，隨著監管審批陸續通過，Cybercab將逐步向全美用戶開放。
不過，他也表示，每月299美元訂閱費用「太高了」，定價應與特斯拉其他車型上FSD及聯網服務費用相當，即每月約115美元。
馬斯克上周曾說，Cybercab未來還會實現一系列效率提升，使電池組容量能降至40kWh。特斯拉還會採用液態銀作為車身顏色，讓整體色彩不會過於單調。
馬斯克重申，Cybercab生產優先級高於Cybertruck。「如果我們必須維持Cybertruck複雜的產線和供應鏈，並為其持續投入工程技術人員，那麼這些人才、工廠和設備就無法用於擴大Cybercab產能。而Cybercab才是真正能夠徹底改變全球陸地交通運輸格局的車型。」
Cybercab作為特斯拉Robotaxi車隊未來主力，配備剪刀門（又稱蝴蝶門），車內沒方向盤、沒油門和剎車踏板，也沒後視鏡。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) announced that invited customers can now order the Cybercab for personal use at a price of about $30,000, with a $1,000 deposit required and a mandatory $299 per month autonomous driving subscription.
The first deliveries are slated to begin in December, initially limited to five cities in Texas and designated areas within the state.
CEO Elon Musk said that as regulatory approvals come through, the Cybercab will be gradually opened to users across the United States.

However, he also noted that the $299 monthly subscription fee is "too high" and should be priced similarly to Tesla's other models' Full Self‑Driving and connectivity services, roughly $115 per month.

Musk said last week that the Cybercab will eventually incorporate a series of efficiency improvements, reducing battery pack capacity to 40 kWh, and will use liquid silver as a body color to avoid a monotonous appearance.

Musk reiterated that Cybercab production takes priority over the Cybertruck, stating that if resources remain tied to the complex Cybertruck production line and its engineering staff, those people, factories, and equipment cannot be used to expand Cybercab capacity, and that Cybercab is the model that can truly transform global land transportation.

The Cybercab, envisioned as the future backbone of Tesla's robotaxi fleet, features scissor (butterfly) doors and an interior without a steering wheel, accelerator or brake pedals, and no rear‑view mirrors.

items.title: 美國問烏克蘭：願放棄頓巴斯換加入北約嗎？
items.title_en: U.S. Asks Ukraine: Will You Trade Donbas for NATO Membership?
paras: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基13日（周五）表示，在最近談判期間，美國代表詢問烏方是否願意從頓巴斯地區撤出軍隊，換取加入北約（NATO）。
據《基輔郵報》報導，澤倫斯基表示，美方在最近一輪外交會談中首次提出這個問題。
他指出，任何包含北約成員資格、具有約束力的安全保證和重建資金的具體方案，都會直接提交給烏克蘭公眾審議。烏方多次強調，不會撤退或放棄主權領土。
「如果美方與其他北約成員國一致向我國確認這一點，我會徵求社會意見：接受還是不接受？」他說，「我無權自行決定。」
澤倫斯基說道：「目前還需要具體細節，這些細節尚不明確，還都在討論中。」
他重申，烏方在任何情況下都不會在法律上承認俄佔烏東領土是俄羅斯的一部分。
paras_en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday the 13th that during recent negotiations, a U.S. representative asked whether Ukraine would be willing to withdraw its forces from the Donbas region in exchange for joining NATO.
According to the Kyiv Post, Zelensky said the United States raised this question for the first time in the latest round of diplomatic talks.

He noted that any concrete package that includes NATO membership, binding security guarantees and reconstruction funding would be submitted directly to the Ukrainian public for review. Kyiv has repeatedly stressed that it will not retreat from or relinquish its sovereign territory.
"If the United States and other NATO members confirm this to me collectively, I will seek public opinion: to accept or not?" he said, "I have no authority to decide on my own."
Zelensky added that specific details are still needed, and those details remain unclear and are still under discussion.
He reiterated that under no circumstances will Ukraine legally recognize the Russian‑occupied eastern Ukrainian territories as part of Russia.

items.title: 輝達醜聞使美商務部長盧特尼克面臨下台危機！《巴隆》恐牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與政府投資
items.title_en: Nvidia Scandal Puts US Commerce Secretary Lutnick in Danger of Ouster! Barron's May Influence Steel, Crypto and Government Investments
paras: 美國商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）因輝達(NVDA-US) 相關爭議遭到政府內外批評，傳出可能面臨去職危機。這場風波不僅牽涉美國對中國的晶片出口管制，也可能影響美國貿易政策、政府入股民間企業的布局，以及鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融等產業。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，爭議焦點在於，盧特尼克未將新加坡企業Megaspeed列入美國限制名單。該公司涉嫌協助將輝達先進晶片轉運至中國，藉此規避美國出口管制。
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週五（13日）接受《CNBC》訪問時，將矛頭指向商務部，批評該部門未將Megaspeed列入限制名單，導致該公司仍能取得美國技術。
盧特尼克預計將就此事赴參議院銀行委員會作證。預測市場Kalshi的交易者則估計，他今年卸任的機率達58%。
這起爭議也與輝達執行長黃仁勳本週辭職，以及他承認對妻子不忠的消息交織。此前有報導指出，黃仁勳曾與Megaspeed一名前高階主管黃樂（Alice Huang）發生婚外情，而美國正調查該名人士是否與中國情報機構有所關聯。

盧特尼克去留牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融業

盧特尼克曾任金融服務公司Cantor Fitzgerald負責人，是川普在貿易談判、加密貨幣政策及華爾街相關議題上的重要幕僚，也主導美國政府擴大直接持有民間企業股權的政策。
Beacon Policy Advisors分析師Tedford指出，近幾個月盧特尼克介入美國與加拿大、墨西哥的貿易談判，力圖避免鋼鐵及鋁材關稅在更廣泛的貿易協議中遭到削弱。
這項立場有利於Cleveland-Cliffs與諾可(NUE-US) 等美國鋼鐵業者，兩家公司高層都曾將關稅視為支撐產業的重要因素。
在加密貨幣領域，盧特尼克同樣是產業支持者之一。去年，川普政府指派他等內閣官員研究如何增加政府持有的加密貨幣，配合川普提出的「戰略比特幣儲備」計畫；今年夏季國會審議有利加密貨幣產業的法案期間，他也曾與業者高層會面。
此外，盧特尼克與美國聯邦住房金融局（FHFA）局長普爾特（Bill Pulte）均支持出售房貸金融巨頭房利美（Fannie Mae）及房地美（Freddie Mac）部分股權。
報導指出，如果盧特尼克不再主掌商務部，上述三個產業的投資人可能面臨更高風險。

輝達風波恐讓美國政府入股企業政策加速

盧特尼克也是川普政府推動入股民間企業政策的主要設計者之一。不過，輝達風波未必會讓這項政策降溫，反而可能促使政府進一步擴大投資。
根據美國外交關係協會（CFR）資料，自2025年1月以來，美國政府已宣布49筆交易，涉及股權投資總額達308億美元，其中包括取得英特爾(INTC-US) 近10%股權。
Raymond James分析師Ed Mills指出，這些投資中有許多是為了降低美國對中國稀土及關鍵礦物供應的依賴。如果輝達醜聞促使川普對中國採取更強硬的立場，中國可能以限制稀土出貨作為反制，讓這類投資變得更加重要。
Mills表示，美中緊張局勢升高，「將加大美國建立自主供應鏈的壓力，也提高美國進一步加碼投資相關企業的可能性」。
paras_en: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is facing criticism from both inside and outside the government over a Nvidia (NVDA-US) controversy, with reports that he may be at risk of removal. The fallout involves US chip export controls on China and could affect US trade policy, government equity stakes in private firms, as well as the steel, cryptocurrency and mortgage finance sectors.

According to Barron’s Weekly, the dispute centers on Lutnick’s failure to place Singapore‑based Megaspeed on the US restricted entities list. The firm is alleged to have helped ship advanced Nvidia chips to China, thereby evading US export controls.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Friday the 13th that the Commerce Department bears responsibility for not adding Megaspeed to the restricted list, allowing the company to continue accessing US technology.
Lutnick is expected to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on the matter. Kalshi market traders estimate his chance of stepping down this year at 58%.

The controversy is intertwined with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation this week and his admission of infidelity. Earlier reports said Huang had an affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, and US investigators are probing whether she has ties to Chinese intelligence agencies.

Lutnick’s fate could affect steel, crypto and mortgage finance. He previously ran Cantor Fitzgerald, served as a key adviser to Trump on trade talks, crypto policy and Wall Street issues, and led the push for expanded government equity stakes in private companies.

Beacon Policy Advisors analyst Tedford noted that in recent months Lutnick has been involved in US‑Canada‑Mexico trade negotiations, seeking to prevent steel and aluminium tariffs from being weakened in broader trade deals.
That stance benefits US steelmakers such as Cleveland‑Cliffs and Nucor (NUE-US), whose executives have long viewed tariffs as a cornerstone of industry support.

In the crypto space, Lutnick is also a supporter. Last year the Trump administration tasked him and other cabinet members with studying how to increase government‑held crypto as part of Trump’s proposed “strategic Bitcoin reserve” plan; this summer, during congressional debate on crypto‑friendly legislation, he met with senior industry leaders.
Lutnick and FHFA Director Bill Pulte have both backed the sale of portions of mortgage giants Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to private investors.
The report warns that if Lutnick leaves the Commerce Department, investors in those three sectors could face heightened risk.
The Nvidia scandal could accelerate the government’s policy of taking equity stakes in private firms.

Lutnick was a chief architect of the Trump administration’s push for government equity in private companies, but the Nvidia episode may not cool the policy; it could instead spur further expansion of government investment.

According to the Council on Foreign Relations, since January 2025 the US government has announced 49 transactions involving a total of $30.8 billion in equity investments, including a near‑10% stake in Intel (INTC-US).

Raymond James analyst Ed Mills said many of those investments aim to reduce US reliance on Chinese rare‑earths and critical minerals, and if the Nvidia scandal pushes Trump to adopt a tougher stance on China, Beijing could retaliate by restricting rare‑earth shipments, making such investments even more vital.

items.title: GLP-1減重藥太貴保險難負擔 CVS：月費降至350美元才有機會打平
items.title_en: GLP-1 Weight‑Loss Drugs Too Expensive for Insurers; CVS Says Monthly Price Must Drop Below $350 to Break Even
paras: 2026年11月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ GLP-1減重藥有助改善患者健康，也可能減少後續住院及急診支出，但高昂藥價仍讓美國企業健康保險難以全面給付。美國醫療保健集團CVS Health(CVS-US)最新研究估算，若GLP-1藥物每月價格降至350美元以下，保險計畫因患者減少就醫而節省的醫療費用，才有機會抵銷新增藥費。
目前藥費距離這個門檻還有一段差距。美國員工福利研究所（EBRI）2025年估計，企業雇主及其他健康保險計畫支付的GLP-1藥物淨成本，約為每人每30天617至766美元，高於CVS估算的350美元。CVS並未透露旗下保險計畫實際支付的平均價格。
CVS追蹤約4,000名持續使用GLP-1藥物三年的患者，發現每人三年累計醫療費用比未用藥的相似患者少9,400美元，但處方藥支出卻多出13,300美元。兩者相抵後，保險計畫平均仍須多負擔3,900美元。
也就是說，保險計畫替患者支付藥費後，雖然可能因患者較少住院或急診而省下部分醫療費用，但節省金額仍不足以彌補藥費增加。CVS估算，若每月藥價降至350美元以下，節省的醫療費用才有機會抵銷藥費，讓企業擴大給付更符合成本效益。
CVS這項研究使用旗下Aetna健康保險的理賠資料，比較2023年至2025年間開始使用GLP-1藥物的患者，以及健康條件相近但未使用藥物的族群，最長追蹤三年。研究涵蓋肥胖、糖尿病及其他疾病患者，使用藥物包括禮來Eli Lilly(LLY-US)的Mounjaro、Zepbound，以及諾和諾德Novo Nordisk(NVO-US)的Ozempic、Wegovy。
藥費能否抵銷，也與患者原本的健康狀況有關。CVS首席醫療長Amy Compton-Phillips指出，住院風險較高的患者，若用藥後減少重大醫療事件，保險計畫可能較快看到費用節省效果；原本健康風險較低的患者，則可能需要更長時間，才能抵銷持續用藥的成本。
研究也發現，使用GLP-1藥物與較少的急診及住院次數有關。由於這是觀察性研究，尚無法直接證明醫療支出下降完全由藥物造成，且未單獨公布肥胖患者的結果。
CVS預計於11月15日在美國HLTH醫療產業大會發表研究結果。對美國企業雇主及健康保險業者而言，未來是否擴大GLP-1給付範圍，除了藥物療效，還須衡量藥價、患者健康風險及長期使用成本。

paras_en: November 14, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – GLP-1 weight‑loss drugs improve patient health and could reduce future hospital and emergency‑room costs, but their high price makes it difficult for U.S. corporate health insurers to cover them fully. CVS Health’s latest study estimates that only if the monthly price falls below $350 will the medical‑cost savings from fewer doctor visits offset the added drug expense.

The price is still far above that threshold. The Employee Benefit Research Institute (EBRI) projected that in 2025 corporate employers and other health plans will pay a net cost of $617‑$766 per person per 30 days for GLP‑1 drugs, well above CVS’s $350 estimate. CVS did not disclose the actual average price its plans pay.

CVS tracked about 4,000 patients who continuously used GLP‑1 drugs for three years and found that each person’s total medical costs over three years were $9,400 lower than similar patients who did not use the drugs, but prescription drug spending was $13,300 higher. After offsetting the two, insurers still had to shoulder an average extra $3,900 per member.

In other words, even after insurers pay for the medication, the savings from fewer hospitalizations or ER visits are not enough to cover the higher drug cost. CVS estimates that only if the monthly price drops below $350 will the saved medical expenses have a chance to offset the drug cost, making broader coverage more cost‑effective for companies.

The study used claims data from CVS’s Aetna health insurance, comparing patients who started GLP‑1 therapy between 2023 and 2025 with a matched cohort who did not use the drugs, with follow‑up up to three years. The analysis covered patients with obesity, diabetes and other conditions, using drugs such as Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro and Zepbound and Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic and Wegovy.

Whether drug costs can be offset also depends on patients’ baseline health. CVS chief medical officer Amy Compton‑Phillips said that high‑risk patients who avoid major medical events after treatment may show cost‑savings more quickly, whereas lower‑risk patients may take longer for the savings to outweigh the ongoing drug expense.

The research also found that GLP‑1 use was associated with fewer ER visits and hospital admissions. Because this is an observational study, it cannot prove that the reduction in medical spending is solely caused by the drugs, and results for obesity‑only patients were not reported separately.

CVS plans to present the findings at the HLTH conference in the United States on November 15. For corporate employers and health insurers, decisions about expanding GLP‑1 coverage will have to weigh not only efficacy but also price, patient health risk and long‑term cost.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元創9月來最大單週漲幅 Fed升息幾成定局
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Posts Biggest Weekly Gain Since September as Fed Rate Hikes Near Certain
paras: 美元周五(13日)再創19個月新高，並寫下9月中旬以來最強單週表現。這波漲勢主要受到市場對美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期大幅升高所帶動。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報103.41，創2025年4月2日以來新高。本週已上漲1.1%。
美元這波漲勢始於上週五美國就業報告公布後。美國10月非農就業人數增加16.5萬人，遠高於市場預期的6.5萬人。此外，8月與9月的就業人數合計上修8.4萬人。
美元週一短暫喘息後，週二再度走高，主要因美國消費者物價指數(CPI)數據高於預期。10月整體CPI月增0.4%，低於9月的0.6%，但仍高於市場預期的0.3%。排除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI月增率維持在0.3%，略高於市場預期的0.2%。
數據顯示，美國勞動市場表現強勁，通膨也持續居高不下。在此情況下，央行通常會採取緊縮貨幣政策。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)週二進一步釋出鷹派訊號，表示即使通膨數據低於預期，他仍支持升息，他並指出，若數據再度偏熱，政策利率甚至可能需要一次調升50個基點，高於一般升息幅度。
週五公布的最新生產者物價指數(PPI)報告，則稍稍緩解市場疑慮。10月整體PPI月增0.3%，明顯低於9月的1.4%，也低於市場預期的0.4%。年增率則為6.5%，略低於預期的6.6%。不過，這仍是2022年11月以來最大的12個月漲幅。
Fifth Third Wealth Advisors投資長Chris Osmond表示，「好消息是，生產者物價通膨已從9月高點降溫。壞消息是，降幅可能還不足以讓市場獲得期待中的利率緩解。生產者物價通膨年增率仍高達6.5%，今天公布的報告提高了限制性利率維持更長時間的風險，恐怕超出投資人原先預期。」

paras_en: The dollar hit a 19‑month high on Friday (the 13th) and recorded its strongest weekly performance since mid‑September. This rally was driven mainly by a sharp rise in market expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.41, a peak not seen since April 2, 2025. It is up 1.1% for the week.

The dollar’s advance began after Friday’s U.S. jobs report. Non‑farm payrolls for October increased by 165,000, far above the 65,000 forecast, and the August‑September combined payroll figure was revised up by 84,000.

After a brief pause on Monday, the dollar moved higher again on Tuesday, largely because U.S. consumer price index (CPI) data came in hotter than expected. October’s overall CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, down from September’s 0.6% but still above the 0.3% market estimate. Core CPI, which strips out volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, slightly above the 0.2% forecast.

The data show a still‑robust labor market and persistently high inflation, conditions that typically prompt central banks to tighten policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaled further hawkishness on Tuesday, saying that even if inflation data miss expectations he still backs a rate hike and noted that a repeat of hot data could warrant a 50‑basis‑point move, larger than the usual increment.

The latest producer price index (PPI) released on Friday eased some concerns. October’s overall PPI rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, well below September’s 1.4% and the 0.4% market forecast. The year‑over‑year rate was 6.5%, just under the 6.6% expected, but it remains the biggest 12‑month gain since November 2022.

Chris Osmond, Chief Investment Officer at Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, said, “The good news is that producer‑price inflation has cooled from its September peak. The bad news is that the decline may not be enough for the market to see the rate‑cut relief it hopes for. Producer‑price inflation is still at a 6.5% annual pace, and today’s report raises the risk that restrictive rates will have to stay in place longer than investors originally expected.”

He added, “Perhaps more important than the headline number is that inflation pressure is spreading from energy to other areas. Energy prices fell in October, but food rose 1.3%, services posted a fifth consecutive month of price gains, and transportation and warehousing costs rose 2.0%. This shows inflation is seeping into the broader economy rather than staying confined to the initial price‑pressure zones. If this continues, it will be harder for the Fed to treat inflation as a temporary phenomenon.”

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders are almost certain the Fed will raise rates in December, with the question being the size of the hike. The market assigns roughly a 90% probability to a 25‑basis‑point increase and about a 10% chance of a 50‑basis‑point move.
The yen slipped past the 160 per dollar barrier again.

A stronger dollar put pressure on the yen, which posted its worst weekly performance since mid‑September. The yen was last quoted at 159.76 per dollar, after briefly touching a low of 160.19 earlier in the session.

This marks the second consecutive trading day the yen fell below the 160 level. It first breached that threshold on Thursday, the first time since September 2. Historically, the 160 barrier has often triggered large‑scale intervention by Tokyo authorities.

Japan’s Ministry of Finance said on Monday that between July and September it intervened in the foreign‑exchange market for a total of ¥15.4 trillion (about $96.38 billion), including a record ¥7.98 trillion on July 30 and ¥5.55 trillion on July 31 when it coordinated an unprecedented joint action with Washington. This is the first time since 1998 that the U.S. and Japan have jointly bought yen.

Atsushi Mimura, the senior official in charge of foreign‑exchange affairs at the Ministry, warned the market to beware of “unilateral moves” and told traders that it was “still too early to say the joint U.S.–Japan intervention is over.”
A stronger dollar also weighed on the euro. The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1022, marking its weakest weekly performance since early October.

Preliminary official estimates released earlier showed Euro‑area GDP grew 0.4% quarter‑on‑quarter in Q3 2026, down from 0.6% in Q2 but in line with expectations. The data also revised labor‑market conditions, indicating that employment growth stalled in the third quarter.
